verses.translation: As the great god JanSrddana* the lord of the Universe,, goes through incarnations, so does Sri to help Him. When Hari assumed the form of a dwsrf, she took birth as a lotus, and when He descended on earth as Parasur&ma, she ap- peared as the Earth. At time of the incarnation of Ráma, she became SitS, and when He was born as Krishna,»she became Rukshmini. And thus in all the incarnations, she assisted Vishnu. When he had a celestial shape, she assumed the shape of a celestial, and when he assumed a human form, she took a human shape. She changed her body (mwian or celestial) according as Vishnu did. Sri does not re- nounce the abode of him for [three generations, who reads or hears of this story of her birth. "0 sage, never can quarrei- some Alakshmi,\ dwell in that house where this hymn of Sri is chaunted. verses.sanskrit: यः कारणं च कार्यं च कारणस्यापि कारणम् कार्यस्यापि च यः कार्यं प्रसीदतु स नो हरिः

verses.sanskrit: यद् योगिनः सदोद्युक्ताः पुण्यपापक्षये ऽक्षयम् पश्यन्ति प्रणवे चिन्त्यं तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम्

verses.hindi: जिसको देवगण , मुनिगण, शंकर और मैं—कोई भी नहीं जान सकते वही परमेश्वर श्रीविष्णुका परमपद है

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उदीरितम् आकर्ण्य ब्रह्मणस् त्रिदशास् ततः प्रणम्योचुः प्रसीदेति व्रज नो दृष्टिगोचरम्

verses.hindi: श्रीपराशरजी बोले— ब्रह्माजीके इन उद्गारोंको सुनकर देवगण भी प्रणाम करके बोले—‘प्रभो! हमपर प्रसन्न होकर हमें दर्शन दीजिये

When Hari assumed the form of a dwsrf, she took birth as a lotus, and when He descended on earth as Parasur&ma, she ap- peared as the Earth. At time of the incarnation of Ráma, she became SitS, and when He was born as Krishna,»she became Rukshmini. And thus in all the incarnations, she assisted Vishnu. When he had a celestial shape, she assumed the shape of a celestial, and when he assumed a human form, she took a human shape. She changed her body (mwian or celestial) according as Vishnu did. Sri does not re- nounce the abode of him for [three generations, who reads or hears of this story of her birth. "0 sage, never can quarrei- some Alakshmi,\ dwell in that house where this hymn of Sri is chaunted. Brahmana, I have related unto thee everything of what thou didst ask me for — how Sri formeriy was born as the daughter of Bhrigu and how she afterwards came out of the Ocean of milk. This eubgy of Lakshmi, the source of all wealth, came out'of the mouth of the Iord of celestials. Poverty can never infest those persons on earth, who chaunt this hymn every day."

verses.transliteration: aśvinau vasavaś ceme sarve caite marudgaṇāḥ sādhyā viśve tathā devā devendraś cāyam īśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: त्वं यज्ञस् त्वं वषट्कारस् त्वम् ओङ्कारः प्रजापतिः वेत्ता वेद्यं च सर्वात्मंस् त्वन्मयं चाखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yajñas tvaṃ vaṣaṭkāras tvam oṅkāraḥ prajāpatiḥ vettā vedyaṃ ca sarvātmaṃs tvanmayaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat
verses.hindi: हे देव! वसुगण, मरुद्गण, साध्यगण और विश्वेदेवगण भी आप ही हैं तथा आपके सम्मुख जो यह देवसमुदाय है, हे जगत्स्रष्टा! वह भी आप ही हैं क्योंकि आप सर्वत्र परिपूर्ण हैं

When Hari assumed the form of a dwsrf, she took birth as a lotus, and when He descended on earth as Parasur&ma, she ap- peared as the Earth. At time of the incarnation of Ráma, she became SitS, and when He was born as Krishna,»she became Rukshmini. And thus in all the incarnations, she assisted Vishnu. verses.transliteration: rūpeṇānyena devānāṃ madhye cakragadādharaḥ cakarṣa nāgarājānaṃ daityamadhye 'pareṇa ca

verses.transliteration: tejasā nāgarājānaṃ tathāpyāyitavān hariḥ anyena tejasā devān upabṛṃhitavān vibhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: रूपौदार्यगुणोपेतस् ततश् चाप्सरसां गणः क्षीरोदधेः समुत्पन्नो मैत्रेय परमाद्भुतः
verses.transliteration: rūpaudāryaguṇopetas tataś cāpsarasāṃ gaṇaḥ kṣīrodadheḥ samutpanno maitreya paramādbhutaḥ
verses.hindi: फिर स्वर्गलोकमें ‘यह क्या है? यह क्या है?’ इस प्रकार चिन्ता करते हुए सिद्धोंके समक्ष मदसे घूमते हुए नेत्रोंवाली वारुणीदेवी प्रकट हुई
verses.translation: As the great god JanSrddana* the lord of the Universe,, goes through incarnations, so does Sri to help Him. When Hari assumed the form of a dwsrf, she took birth as a lotus, and when He descended on earth as Parasur&ma, she ap- peared as the Earth. At time of the incarnation of Ráma, she became SitS, and when He was born as Krishna,»she became Rukshmini. And thus in all the incarnations, she assisted Vishnu. When he had a celestial shape, she assumed the shape of a celestial, and when he assumed a human form, she took a human shape. She changed her body (mwian or celestial) according as Vishnu did. Sri does not re- nounce the abode of him for [three generations, who reads or hears of this story of her birth. "0 sage, never can quarrei- some Alakshmi,\ dwell in that house where this hymn of Sri is chaunted. Brahmana, I have related unto thee everything of what thou didst ask me for — how Sri formeriy was born as the daughter of Bhrigu and how she afterwards came out of the Ocean of milk. This eubgy of Lakshmi, the source of all wealth, came out'of the mouth of the Iord of celestials. Poverty can never infest those persons on earth, who chaunt this hymn every day."
verses.explanation: श्रुव बोले--पृथिवी, जल, अग्नि, वायु, आकाश, मन, बुद्धि, अहंकार और मूल-प्रकृति--ये सब जिनके रूप हैं उन भगवान्को में नमस्कार करता हूँ। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: श्रुव बोले--पृथिवी, जल, अग्नि, वायु, आकाश, मन, बुद्धि, अहंकार और मूल-प्रकृति--ये सब जिनके रूप हैं उन भगवान्को में नमस्कार करता हूँ। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः शीतांशुर् अभवज् जगृहे तं महेश्वरः जगृहुश् च विषं नागाः क्षीरोदाब्धिसमुत्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śītāṃśur abhavaj jagṛhe taṃ maheśvaraḥ jagṛhuś ca viṣaṃ nāgāḥ kṣīrodābdhisamutthitam
verses.hindi: और पुन: मन्थन करनेपर उस क्षीर-सागरसे, अपनी गन्धसे त्रिलोकीको सुगन्धित करनेवाला तथा सुर-सुन्दरियोंका आनन्दवर्धक कल्पवृक्ष उत्पन्न हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततो धन्वन्तरिर् देवः श्वेताम्बरधरः स्वयम् बिभ्रत्कमण्डलुं पूर्णम् अमृतस्य समुत्थितः
verses.transliteration: tato dhanvantarir devaḥ śvetāmbaradharaḥ svayam bibhratkamaṇḍaluṃ pūrṇam amṛtasya samutthitaḥ

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वस्थमनस्कास् ते सर्वे दैतेयदानवाः बभूवुर् मुदिताः सद्यो मैत्रेय मुनिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svasthamanaskās te sarve daiteyadānavāḥ babhūvur muditāḥ sadyo maitreya munibhiḥ saha
verses.hindi: फिर चन्द्रमा प्रकट हुआ जिसे महादेवजीने ग्रहण कर लिया। इसी प्रकार क्षीर-सागरसे उत्पन्न हुए विषको नागोंने ग्रहण किया

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्फुरत्कान्तिमती विकासिकमले स्थिता श्रीर् देवी पयसस् तस्माद् उत्थिता धृतपङ्कजा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sphuratkāntimatī vikāsikamale sthitā śrīr devī payasas tasmād utthitā dhṛtapaṅkajā

verses.sanskrit: तां तुष्टुवुर् मुदा युक्ताः श्रीसूक्तेन महर्षयः

verses.transliteration: gaṅgādyāḥ saritas toyaiḥ snānārtham upatasthire diggajā hemapātrastham ādāya vimalaṃ jalam snāpayāṃ cakrire devīṃ sarvalokamaheśvarīm

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदो रूपधृक् तस्यै मालाम् अम्लानपङ्कजाम् ददौ विभूषणान्य् अङ्गे विश्वकर्मा चकार ह
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodo rūpadhṛk tasyai mālām amlānapaṅkajām dadau vibhūṣaṇāny aṅge viśvakarmā cakāra ha

verses.transliteration: divyamālyāmbaradharā snātā bhūṣaṇabhūṣitā paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ yayau vakṣaḥsthalaṃ hareḥ

verses.transliteration: tato 'valokitā devā harivakṣaḥsthalasthayā lakṣmyā maitreya sahasā parāṃ nirvṛtim āgatāḥ

verses.sanskrit: उद्वेगं परमं जग्मुर् दैत्या विष्णुपराङ्मुखाः त्यक्ता लक्ष्म्या महाभाग विप्रचित्तिपुरोगमाः

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वेन सत्यशौचाभ्यां तथा शीलादिभिर् गुणैः त्यज्यन्ते ते नराः सद्यः संत्यक्ता ये त्वयामले
verses.transliteration: sattvena satyaśaucābhyāṃ tathā śīlādibhir guṇaiḥ tyajyante te narāḥ sadyaḥ saṃtyaktā ye tvayāmale
verses.hindi: तुम सम्पूर्ण लोकोंकी माता हो और देवदेव भगवान् हरि पिता हैं। हे मात:! तुमसे और श्रीविष्णुभगवान्‌से यह सकल चराचर जगत् व्याप्त है
verses.translation: As the great god JanSrddana* the lord of the Universe,, goes through incarnations, so does Sri to help Him. When Hari assumed the form of a dwsrf, she took birth as a lotus, and when He descended on earth as Parasur&ma, she ap- peared as the Earth. At time of the incarnation of Ráma, she became SitS, and when He was born as Krishna,»she became Rukshmini. And thus in all the incarnations, she assisted Vishnu. When he had a celestial shape, she assumed the shape of a celestial, and when he assumed a human form, she took a human shape. She changed her body (mwian or celestial) according as Vishnu did. Sri does not re- nounce the abode of him for [three generations, who reads or hears of this story of her birth. "0 sage, never can quarrei- some Alakshmi,\ dwell in that house where this hymn of Sri is chaunted. Brahmana, I have related unto thee everything of what thou didst ask me for — how Sri formeriy was born as the daughter of Bhrigu and how she afterwards came out of the Ocean of milk. This eubgy of Lakshmi, the source of all wealth, came out'of the mouth of the Iord of celestials. Poverty can never infest those persons on earth, who chaunt this hymn every day."
verses.explanation: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--हे महामते! इस प्रकार। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: त्वयावलोकिताः सद्यः शीलाद्यैर् अखिलैर् गुणैः कुलैश्वर्यैश् च युज्यन्ते पुरुषा निर्गुणा अपि
verses.transliteration: tvayāvalokitāḥ sadyaḥ śīlādyair akhilair guṇaiḥ kulaiśvaryaiś ca yujyante puruṣā nirguṇā api

verses.sanskrit: स श्लाघ्यः स गुणी धन्यः स कुलीनः स बुद्धिमान् स शूरः स च विक्रान्तो यस् त्वया देवि वीक्षितः
verses.transliteration: sa ślāghyaḥ sa guṇī dhanyaḥ sa kulīnaḥ sa buddhimān sa śūraḥ sa ca vikrānto yas tvayā devi vīkṣitaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सद्यो वैगुण्यम् आयान्ति शीलाद्याः सकला गुणाः पराङ्मुखी जगद्धात्री यस्य त्वं विष्णुवल्लभे
verses.transliteration: sadyo vaiguṇyam āyānti śīlādyāḥ sakalā guṇāḥ parāṅmukhī jagaddhātrī yasya tvaṃ viṣṇuvallabhe

verses.transliteration: na te varṇayituṃ śaktā guṇāñ jihvāpi vedhasaḥ prasīda devi padmākṣi māsmāṃs tyākṣīḥ kadācana

verses.sanskrit: एवं श्रीः संस्तुता सम्यक् प्राह हृष्टा शतक्रतुम् शृण्वतां सर्वदेवानां सर्वभूतस्थिता द्विज

verses.translation: born of Bhrigu and Kyati namely Dhata and Bidliata. Two daughters, by name Ayati and Niyati were born of the high- souled Meru. And DliJta and Bidháta took them as their wives. Theý* gave birth to two sons named PrSna and Mirkandu. Of Mirkandu again was born a son named Márkandeya. And hear then again, a'son was born of Prðna by name Vedacira. Of the other sons of Prána one vvas named Kritim&n and the other Rájaván. And in this way did spread the family of the great Ðhrigu. Maricha's spouse Sargljhuti gave birth to a son named Paurnamasam. And of him were born two sons named Birajá and Sarvaga. And their sons I shall mention, twice-born one, when I shall relate the lineage at leisure. And Angiri's wife Smriti gave birth to four daughters, named Sinibali, Kuhoo, Rák5 and Anumati. And by Atri, Anasuya gave birth to three sons untouched by sin named Soma, Durblsi and the sage Dattatreyo. And Pulastya's wife Preeti gave birth to a child named Dattoli, who in his former birth or in the Sayambhava Manwlntara was known as the sage Agistya. KshamJ, the wife of the Patriarch Pulaha was the mother of three sons; Kardama, Avarian and Sahishnu. The wife of Kratu, Sannati, brought forth the sixty tliousand BSlakhilyas, pigmy sages, no bigger than a joint of the thumb, chaste, pious. resplendent as the rays of the Sun. Vasishtha had seven sons by his wife Urjja, Rajas, Gatra, Urdhabhahu, Basana, Anagha, Sutapas and Sukra, the seven pure sages. The Agni, named Abhimani, who is the eldest born of BrahmS, had, by SwahS, three sons of surpassing brilliancy :— Pavaka, Pavamana and Suchi who drinks up water. They had forty- five sons who (with the son of Brahma, the Agni named Abhimani and his three descendants) constitute the forty-nine Fires. I have mentioned the progenitors (Pritras) who were created by Brahma. Of those by Agnishwattas and Varhishads the former being devoid and the latter, possesaed of Fires*

verses.science: हे मुनिवरो ! उन तीव्र वेगवाले परधनहारी चोरोंके उत्पातसे ही यह बड़ी भारी धूलि उड़ती दीख रही है''। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणस्य द्युतिमान् पुत्रो राजवांश् च ततो ऽभवत् ततो वंशो महाभाग विस्तारं भार्गवो गतः
verses.transliteration: prāṇasya dyutimān putro rājavāṃś ca tato 'bhavat tato vaṃśo mahābhāga vistāraṃ bhārgavo gataḥ
verses.translation: * Aceording to the cooimentatot this distinction i» derived frem the
verses.hindi: प्राणका पुत्र द्युतिमान् और उसका पुत्र राजवान् हुआ। हे महाभाग! उस राजवान्से फिर भृगुवंशका बड़ा विस्तार हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: * Aceording to the cooimentatot this distinction i» derived frem the
verses.science: तब उन सब मुनीश्वरोंने आपसमें सलाह कर उस। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी मरीचेः संभूतिः पौर्णमासम् असूयत विरजाः पर्वतश् चैव तस्य पुत्रौ महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: patnī marīceḥ saṃbhūtiḥ paurṇamāsam asūyata virajāḥ parvataś caiva tasya putrau mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.hindi: मरीचिकी पत्नी सम्भूतिने पौर्णमासको उत्पन्न किया। उस महात्माके विरजा और पर्वत दो पुत्र थे
verses.wordMeaning: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities.…
verses.explanation: उसकी जंघाके मथनेपर उससे एक पुरुष। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: उसकी जंघाके मथनेपर उससे एक पुरुष। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वंशसंकीर्तने पुत्रान् वदिष्ये ऽहं ततो द्विज स्मृतिश् चाङ्गिरसः पत्नी प्रसूता कन्यकास् तथा सिनीवाली कुहूश् चैव राका चानुमती तथा
verses.transliteration: vaṃśasaṃkīrtane putrān vadiṣye 'haṃ tato dvija smṛtiś cāṅgirasaḥ patnī prasūtā kanyakās tathā sinīvālī kuhūś caiva rākā cānumatī tathā
verses.hindi: हे द्विज! उनके वंशका वर्णन करते समय मैं उन दोनोंकी सन्तानका वर्णन करूँगा। अंगिराकी पत्नी स्मृति थी, उसके सिनीवाली, कुहू, राका और अनुमति नामकी कन्याएँ हुईं
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: उसने अति आतुर होकर ““निषीद (बैठ) '” अत: वह 'निषाद' कहलाया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: उसने अति आतुर होकर ““निषीद (बैठ) '” अत: वह 'निषाद' कहलाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनसूया तथैवात्रेर् जज्ञे पुत्रान् अकल्मषान् सोमं दुर्वाससं चैव दत्तात्रेयं च योगिनम्
verses.transliteration: anasūyā tathaivātrer jajñe putrān akalmaṣān somaṃ durvāsasaṃ caiva dattātreyaṃ ca yoginam
verses.hindi: अत्रिकी भार्या अनसूयाने चन्द्रमा, दुर्वासा और योगी दत्तात्रेय—इन निष्पाप पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: उस निषादरूप द्वारसे राजा वेनका सम्पूर्ण पाप निकल गया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: उस निषादरूप द्वारसे राजा वेनका सम्पूर्ण पाप निकल गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यभार्यायां दत्तोलिस् तत्सुतो ऽभवत् पूर्वजन्मनि सो ऽगस्त्यः स्मृतः स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: prītyāṃ pulastyabhāryāyāṃ dattolis tatsuto 'bhavat pūrvajanmani so 'gastyaḥ smṛtaḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare
verses.hindi: पुलस्त्यकी स्त्री प्रीतिसे दत्तोलिका जन्म हुआ जो अपने पूर्व जन्ममें स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरमें अगस्त्य कहा जाता था
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: फिर उन ब्राह्मणोंने उसके दायें हाथका मन्थन किया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: फिर उन ब्राह्मणोंने उसके दायें हाथका मन्थन किया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्दमश् चार्वरीवांश् च सहिष्णुश् च सुतत्रयम् क्षमा तु सुषुवे भार्या पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: kardamaś cārvarīvāṃś ca sahiṣṇuś ca sutatrayam kṣamā tu suṣuve bhāryā pulahasya prajāpateḥ
verses.hindi: प्रजापति पुलहकी पत्नी क्षमासे कर्दम, उर्वरीयान् और सहिष्णु ये तीन पुत्र हुए
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: पितामहश्च भगवान्देवैराड्िरसे: सह। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पितामहश्च भगवान्देवैराड्िरसे: सह। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रतोश् च सन्नतिर् भार्या वालखिल्यान् असूयत षष्टिस् तानि सहस्राणि ऋषीणाम् ऊर्ध्वरेतसाम् अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्राणां ज्वलद्भास्करतेजसाम्
verses.transliteration: kratoś ca sannatir bhāryā vālakhilyān asūyata ṣaṣṭis tāni sahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇām ūrdhvaretasām aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāṇāṃ jvaladbhāskaratejasām
verses.hindi: क्रतुकी सन्तति नामक भार्याने अँगूठेके पोरुओंके समान शरीरवाले तथा प्रखर सूर्यके समान तेजस्वी वालखिल्यादि साठ हजार ऊर्ध्वरेता मुनियोंको जन्म दिया
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: उस समय आंगिरस देवगणोंके सहित वहाँ आकर महाराज वैन्य (वेनपुत्र)-का राज्याभिषेक किया ॥ ४ ४ ॥ उनके दाहिने हाथमें चक्रका चिह्न देखकर उन्हें। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: उस समय आंगिरस देवगणोंके सहित वहाँ आकर महाराज वैन्य (वेनपुत्र)-का राज्याभिषेक किया ॥ ४ ४ ॥ उनके दाहिने हाथमें चक्रका चिह्न देखकर उन्हें। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जायां च वसिष्ठस्य सप्ताजायन्त वै सुताः
verses.transliteration: ūrjāyāṃ ca vasiṣṭhasya saptājāyanta vai sutāḥ
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठकी ऊर्जा नामक स्त्रीसे रज, गोत्र, ऊर्ध्वबाहु, सवन, अनघ, सुतपा और शुक्र ये सात पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। ये निर्मल स्वभाववाले समस्त मुनिगण [तीसरे मन्वन्तरमें] सप्तर्षि हुए
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: चक्रवर्ती राजाओंके हाथमें हुआ करता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: चक्रवर्ती राजाओंके हाथमें हुआ करता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रजो गोत्रोर्ध्वबाहुश् च सवनश् चानघस् तथा सुतपाः शुक्र इत्य् एते सर्वे सप्तर्षयो ऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: rajo gotrordhvabāhuś ca savanaś cānaghas tathā sutapāḥ śukra ity ete sarve saptarṣayo 'malāḥ
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: राजराजेश्वरपदपर अभिषिक्त हुए। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: राजराजेश्वरपदपर अभिषिक्त हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽसाव् अग्निर् अभिमानी ब्रह्मणस् तनयो ऽग्रजः तस्मात् स्वाहा सुतांल् लेभे त्रीन् उदारौजसो द्विज
verses.transliteration: yo 'sāv agnir abhimānī brahmaṇas tanayo 'grajaḥ tasmāt svāhā sutāṃl lebhe trīn udāraujaso dvija
verses.hindi: हे द्विज! अग्निका अभिमानी देव, जो ब्रह्माजीका ज्येष्ठ पुत्र है, उसके द्वारा स्वाहा नामक पत्नीसे अति तेजस्वी पावक, पवमान और जलको भक्षण करनेवाला शुचि—ये तीन पुत्र हुए
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: अनुरंजित (प्रसन्‍न) किया, इसलिये अनुरंजन करनेसे उनका। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: अनुरंजित (प्रसन्‍न) किया, इसलिये अनुरंजन करनेसे उनका। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पावकं पवमानं च शुचिं चापि जलाशिनम्
verses.transliteration: pāvakaṃ pavamānaṃ ca śuciṃ cāpi jalāśinam
verses.translation: Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidharini. They were both, twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimble qualities. 'Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence,shall never want offsprin^.
verses.explanation: जब वे समुद्रमें चलते थे तो जल बहनेसे रुक जाता था, पर्वत उन्हें मार्ग देते थे और उनकी ध्वजा कभी भंग नहीं हुई। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.science: बिना जोते-बोये धान्य पकानेवाली थी; केवल चिन्तनमात्रसे ही अन्न सिद्ध हो जाता था, गौएँ कामधेनुरूपा थीं और पत्ते-पत्तेमें मधु भरा रहता था। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.translation: Dhruva said :— " mother, what thou liast said to console me doth not find place in my heart vvliicii has been rent asunder by harsh words. I shall so exert that I may attain to the most exalted rank adored by the vvhole vvorld. I am not born of Suruchi who is the favourite wifeof theking. Parasara said : — " Having addressed his mother tlius, Dliruva issued out of his mother's dwelling. And quitting the city, he repaired to a neighbouring thicket. He beheld there seven ascetics, who had repaired there before, sitting upon the hides of the black antelope, which they had taken from off their person9, and spread over the holy kusa grass. Saluting them respectfully and bowing unto them humbly the prince said, " Do ye kuow me, great ascetics, as the son of Uttanpada, born of Suniti. verses.sanskrit: वत्स कः कोपहेतुस् ते कश् च त्वां नाभिनन्दति को ऽवजानाति पितरं तव यस् ते ऽपराध्यति
verses.transliteration: vatsa kaḥ kopahetus te kaś ca tvāṃ nābhinandati ko 'vajānāti pitaraṃ tava yas te 'parādhyati
verses.hindi: ‘‘बेटा! तेरे क्रोधका क्या कारण है? तेरा किसने आदर नहीं किया? तेरा अपराध करके कौन तेरे पिताजीका अपमान करने चला है?’’
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: भयसे अत्यन्त व्याकुल हुई पृथिवी गौका रूप धारणकर भागी और ब्रह्मलोक आदि सभी लोकॉमें गयी। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: भयसे अत्यन्त व्याकुल हुई पृथिवी गौका रूप धारणकर भागी और ब्रह्मलोक आदि सभी लोकॉमें गयी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तः सकलं मात्रे कथयाम् आस तद् यथा सुरुचिः प्राह भूपालप्रत्यक्षम् अतिगर्विता
verses.transliteration: ity uktaḥ sakalaṃ mātre kathayām āsa tad yathā suruciḥ prāha bhūpālapratyakṣam atigarvitā
verses.hindi: श्रीपराशरजी बोले— ऐसा पूछनेपर ध्रुवने अपनी मातासे वे सब बातें कह दीं जो अति गर्वीली सुरुचिने उससे पिताके सामने कही थीं
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: समस्त भूतोंको धारण करनेवाली पृथिवी जहाँ-जहाँ भी गयी। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: समस्त भूतोंको धारण करनेवाली पृथिवी जहाँ-जहाँ भी गयी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निःश्वस्य सेति कथिते तस्मिन् पुत्रेण दुर्मनाः श्वासक्षामेक्षणा दीना सुनीतिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: niḥśvasya seti kathite tasmin putreṇa durmanāḥ śvāsakṣāmekṣaṇā dīnā sunītir vākyam abravīt
verses.hindi: अपने पुत्रके सिसक- सिसककर ऐसा कहनेपर दु:खिनी सुनीतिने खिन्नचित्त और दीर्घ नि:श्वासके कारण मलिननयना होकर कहा
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: प्रजानामुपकाराय यदि मां त्वं हनिष्यसि। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: प्रजानामुपकाराय यदि मां त्वं हनिष्यसि। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरुचिः सत्यम् आहेदं स्वल्पभाग्यो ऽसि पुत्रक न हि पुण्यवतां वत्स सपत्नैर् एवम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: suruciḥ satyam āhedaṃ svalpabhāgyo 'si putraka na hi puṇyavatāṃ vatsa sapatnair evam ucyate
verses.hindi: सुनीति बोली— बेटा! सुरुचिने ठीक ही कहा है, अवश्य ही तू मन्दभाग्य है। हे वत्स! पुण्यवानोंसे उनके विपक्षी ऐसा नहीं कह सकते
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: वधका महापाप नहीं दीख पड़ता, जो मुझे मारनेपर आप ऐसे उतारू हो रहे हैं ?। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: वधका महापाप नहीं दीख पड़ता, जो मुझे मारनेपर आप ऐसे उतारू हो रहे हैं ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नोद्वेगस् तात कर्तव्यः कृतं यद् भवता पुरा तत् को ऽपहर्तुं शक्नोति दातुं कश् चाकृतं त्वया तत् त्वया नात्र कर्तव्यं दुःखं तद्वाक्यसंभवम्
verses.transliteration: nodvegas tāta kartavyaḥ kṛtaṃ yad bhavatā purā tat ko 'pahartuṃ śaknoti dātuṃ kaś cākṛtaṃ tvayā tat tvayā nātra kartavyaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadvākyasaṃbhavam
verses.hindi: बच्चा! तू व्याकुल मत हो, क्योंकि तूने पूर्व-जन्मोंमें जो कुछ किया है उसे दूर कौन कर सकता है? और जो नहीं किया वह तुझे दे भी कौन सकता है? इसलिये तुझे उसके वाक्योंसे खेद नहीं करना चाहिये
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: पृथु बोले--जहाँ एक अनर्थकारीको मार देनेसे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पृथु बोले--जहाँ एक अनर्थकारीको मार देनेसे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजासनं तथा छत्रं वराश्वा वरवारणाः यस्य पुण्यानि तस्यैव मत्वैतच् छाम्य पुत्रक
verses.transliteration: rājāsanaṃ tathā chatraṃ varāśvā varavāraṇāḥ yasya puṇyāni tasyaiva matvaitac chāmya putraka
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: पृथिवी बोली--हे नृपश्रेष्ठ ! यदि आप प्रजाके हितके लिये ही मुझे मारना चाहते हैं तो मेरे मर जानेपर आपकी प्रजाका आधार क्या होगा 2। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पृथिवी बोली--हे नृपश्रेष्ठ ! यदि आप प्रजाके हितके लिये ही मुझे मारना चाहते हैं तो मेरे मर जानेपर आपकी प्रजाका आधार क्या होगा 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यजन्मकृतैः पुण्यैः सुरुच्यां सुरुचिर् नृपः भार्येति प्रोच्यते चान्या मद्विधा पुण्यवर्जिता
verses.transliteration: anyajanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyaiḥ surucyāṃ surucir nṛpaḥ bhāryeti procyate cānyā madvidhā puṇyavarjitā
verses.hindi: हे वत्स! जिसका पुण्य होता है उसीको राजासन , राजच्छत्र तथा उत्तम-उत्तम घोड़े और हाथी आदि मिलते हैं—ऐसा जानकर तू शान्त हो जा
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: पृथुने कहा--अरी वसुधे! अपनी आज्ञाका उल्लंघन करनेवाली तुझे मारकर मैं अपने योगबलसे ही इस प्रजाको धारण करूँगा। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पृथुने कहा--अरी वसुधे! अपनी आज्ञाका उल्लंघन करनेवाली तुझे मारकर मैं अपने योगबलसे ही इस प्रजाको धारण करूँगा। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: पुण्योपचयसंपन्नस् तस्याः पुत्रस् तथोत्तमः मम पुत्रस् तथा जातः स्वल्पपुण्यो ध्रुवो भवान्
verses.transliteration: puṇyopacayasaṃpannas tasyāḥ putras tathottamaḥ mama putras tathā jātaḥ svalpapuṇyo dhruvo bhavān
verses.hindi: अन्य जन्मोंमें किये हुए पुण्य-कर्मोंके कारण ही सुरुचिमें राजाकी सुरुचि (प्रीति) है और पुण्यहीना होनेसे ही मुझ-जैसी स्त्री केवल भार्या (भरण करनेयोग्य) ही कही जाती है
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--तब अत्यन्त भयभीत एवं काँपती हुई पृथिवीने उन पृथिवीपतिको पुनः प्रणाम। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--तब अत्यन्त भयभीत एवं काँपती हुई पृथिवीने उन पृथिवीपतिको पुनः प्रणाम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथापि दुःखं न भवान् कर्तुम् अर्हति पुत्रक यस्य यावत् स तेनैव स्वेन तुष्यति बुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi duḥkhaṃ na bhavān kartum arhati putraka yasya yāvat sa tenaiva svena tuṣyati buddhimān
verses.hindi: उसी प्रकार उसका पुत्र उत्तम भी बड़ा पुण्यपुंज-सम्पन्न है और मेरा पुत्र तू ध्रुव मेरे समान ही अल्प पुण्यवान् है
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: किये हुए सभी कार्य सिद्ध हो जाते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: यदि चेद् दुःखम् अत्यर्थं सुरुच्या वचनात् तव तत् पुण्योपचये यत्नं कुरु सर्वफलप्रदे
verses.transliteration: yadi ced duḥkham atyarthaṃ surucyā vacanāt tava tat puṇyopacaye yatnaṃ kuru sarvaphalaprade
verses.hindi: तथापि बेटा! तुझे दु:खी नहीं होना चाहिये, क्योंकि जिस मनुष्यको जितना मिलता है वह अपनी ही पूँजीमें मग्न रहता है
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: समस्त ओषधियोंको पचा लिया है उन्हें यदि आपको इच्छा हो तो दुग्धरूपसे मैं दे सकती हूँ। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: समस्त ओषधियोंको पचा लिया है उन्हें यदि आपको इच्छा हो तो दुग्धरूपसे मैं दे सकती हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुशीलो भव धर्मात्मा मैत्रः प्राणिहिते रतः निम्नं यथापः प्रवणाः पात्रम् आयान्ति संपदः
verses.transliteration: suśīlo bhava dharmātmā maitraḥ prāṇihite rataḥ nimnaṃ yathāpaḥ pravaṇāḥ pātram āyānti saṃpadaḥ
verses.hindi: और यदि सुरुचिके वाक्योंसे तुझे अत्यन्त दु:ख ही हुआ है तो सर्व फलदायक पुण्यके संग्रह करनेका प्रयत्न कर
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: लिये कोई ऐसा वत्स (बछड़ा) बनाइये जिससे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: लिये कोई ऐसा वत्स (बछड़ा) बनाइये जिससे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अम्ब यत् त्वम् इदं प्राह प्रशमाय वचो मम नैतद् दुर्वचसा भिन्ने हृदये मम तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: amba yat tvam idaṃ prāha praśamāya vaco mama naitad durvacasā bhinne hṛdaye mama tiṣṭhati
verses.hindi: तू सुशील, पुण्यात्मा, प्रेमी और समस्त प्राणियोंका हितैषी बन, क्योंकि जैसे नीची भूमिकी ओर ढलकता हुआ जल अपने-आप ही पात्रमें आ जाता है वैसे ही सत्पात्र मनुष्यके पास स्वत: ही समस्त सम्पत्तियाँ आ जाती हैं
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: और मुझको आप सर्वत्र समतल कर दीजिये जिससे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: और मुझको आप सर्वत्र समतल कर दीजिये जिससे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं तथा यतिष्यामि यथा सर्वोत्तमोत्तमम् स्थानं प्राप्स्याम्य् अशेषाणां जगताम् अभिपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ tathā yatiṣyāmi yathā sarvottamottamam sthānaṃ prāpsyāmy aśeṣāṇāṃ jagatām abhipūjitam
verses.hindi: ध्रुव बोला— माताजी! तुमने मेरे चित्तको शान्त करनेके लिये जो वचन कहे हैं वे दुर्वाक्योंसे बिंधे हुए मेरे हृदयमें तनिक भी नहीं ठहरते
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--तब महाराज पृथुने अपने धनुपकी कोटिसे सेकड़ों-हजारों पर्वतोंको उखाड़ा और उन्हें एक स्थानपर इकट्ठा कर दिया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--तब महाराज पृथुने अपने धनुपकी कोटिसे सेकड़ों-हजारों पर्वतोंको उखाड़ा और उन्हें एक स्थानपर इकट्ठा कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरुचिर् दयिता राज्ञस् तस्या जातो ऽस्मि नोदरात् प्रभावं पश्य मे ऽम्ब त्वं धृतस्यापि तवोदरे
verses.transliteration: surucir dayitā rājñas tasyā jāto 'smi nodarāt prabhāvaṃ paśya me 'mba tvaṃ dhṛtasyāpi tavodare
verses.hindi: इसलिये मैं तो अब वही प्रयत्न करूँगा जिससे सम्पूर्ण लोकोंसे आदरणीय सर्वश्रेष्ठ पदको प्राप्त कर सकूँ
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: इससे पूर्व पृथिवीके समतल न होनेसे पुर और ग्राम आदिका कोई नियमित विभाग नहीं था। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: इससे पूर्व पृथिवीके समतल न होनेसे पुर और ग्राम आदिका कोई नियमित विभाग नहीं था। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमः स मम भ्राता यो गर्भेण धृतस् तया स राजासनम् आप्नोतु पित्रा दत्तं तथास्तु तत्
verses.transliteration: uttamaḥ sa mama bhrātā yo garbheṇa dhṛtas tayā sa rājāsanam āpnotu pitrā dattaṃ tathāstu tat
verses.hindi: राजाकी प्रेयसी तो अवश्य सुरुचि ही है और मैंने उसके उदरसे जन्म भी नहीं लिया है, तथापि हे माता! अपने गर्भमें बढ़े हुए मेरा प्रभाव भी तुम देखना
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: और व्यापारका भी कोई क्रम न था। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: और व्यापारका भी कोई क्रम न था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नान्यदत्तम् अभीप्स्यामि स्थानम् अम्ब स्वकर्मणा इच्छामि तद् अहं स्थानं यन् न प्राप पिता मम
verses.transliteration: nānyadattam abhīpsyāmi sthānam amba svakarmaṇā icchāmi tad ahaṃ sthānaṃ yan na prāpa pitā mama
verses.hindi: उत्तम, जिसको उसने अपने गर्भमें धारण किया है, मेरा भाई ही है। पिताका दिया हुआ राजासन वही प्राप्त करे। [ भगवान् करें ] ऐसा ही हो
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: हे द्विजोत्तम! जहाँ-जहाँ भूमि समतल थी वहीं- वहींपर प्रजाने निवास करना पसन्द किया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: हे द्विजोत्तम! जहाँ-जहाँ भूमि समतल थी वहीं- वहींपर प्रजाने निवास करना पसन्द किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्जगाम गृहान् मातुर् इत्य् उक्त्वा मातरं ध्रुवः पुराच् च निर्गम्य ततस् तद्बाह्योपवनं ययौ
verses.transliteration: nirjagāma gṛhān mātur ity uktvā mātaraṃ dhruvaḥ purāc ca nirgamya tatas tadbāhyopavanaṃ yayau
verses.hindi: माताजी! मैं किसी दूसरेके दिये हुए पदका इच्छुक नहीं हूँ; मैं तो अपने पुरुषार्थसे ही उस पदकी इच्छा करता हूँ जिसको पिताजीने भी नहीं प्राप्त किया है
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: समयतक प्रजाका आहार केवल फल मूलादि ही था; वह भी ओषधियोंके नष्ट हो जानेसे बड़ा दुर्लभ हो। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: समयतक प्रजाका आहार केवल फल मूलादि ही था; वह भी ओषधियोंके नष्ट हो जानेसे बड़ा दुर्लभ हो। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: स ददर्श मुनींस् तत्र सप्त पूर्वागतान् ध्रुवः कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयेषु विष्टरेषु समास्थितान्
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa munīṃs tatra sapta pūrvāgatān dhruvaḥ kṛṣṇājinottarīyeṣu viṣṭareṣu samāsthitān
verses.hindi: श्रीपराशरजी बोले— मातासे इस प्रकार कह ध्रुव उसके महलसे निकल पड़ा और फिर नगरसे बाहर आकर बाहरी उपवनमें पहुँचा
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. verses.explanation: तब पृथिवीपति पृथुने स्वायम्भुवमनुको बछड़ा बनाकर अपने हाथमें ही पृथिवीसे प्रजाके हितके लिये समस्त धान्योंकों दुहा। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तब पृथिवीपति पृथुने स्वायम्भुवमनुको बछड़ा बनाकर अपने हाथमें ही पृथिवीसे प्रजाके हितके लिये समस्त धान्योंकों दुहा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स राजपुत्रस् तान् सर्वान् प्रणिपत्याभ्यभाषत प्रश्रयावनतः सम्यग् अभिवादनपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: sa rājaputras tān sarvān praṇipatyābhyabhāṣata praśrayāvanataḥ samyag abhivādanapūrvakam
verses.hindi: वहाँ ध्रुवने पहलेसे ही आये हुए सात मुनीश्वरोंको कृष्ण मृग-चर्मके बिछौनोंसे युक्त आसनोंपर बैठे देखा
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपादतनयं मां निबोधत सत्तमाः जातं सुनीत्यां निर्वेदाद् युष्माकं प्राप्तम् अन्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: uttānapādatanayaṃ māṃ nibodhata sattamāḥ jātaṃ sunītyāṃ nirvedād yuṣmākaṃ prāptam antikam
verses.hindi: उस राजकुमारने उन सबको प्रणाम कर अति नम्रता और समुचित अभिवादनादिपूर्वक उनसे कहा
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: पूर्वकालमें वेनके पुत्र महाराज पृथु ऐसे प्रभावशाली और वीर्यवान् हुए। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पूर्वकालमें वेनके पुत्र महाराज पृथु ऐसे प्रभावशाली और वीर्यवान् हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुःपञ्चाब्दसंभूतो बालस् त्वं नृपनन्दन निर्वेदकारणं किंचित् तव नाद्यापि विद्यते
verses.transliteration: catuḥpañcābdasaṃbhūto bālas tvaṃ nṛpanandana nirvedakāraṇaṃ kiṃcit tava nādyāpi vidyate
verses.hindi: ध्रुवने कहा— हे महात्माओ! मुझे आप सुनीतिसे उत्पन्न हुआ राजा उत्तानपादका पुत्र जानें। मैं आत्म- ग्लानिके कारण आपके निकट आया हूँ
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: जो मनुष्य महाराज पृथुके इस चरित्रका कीर्तन करता हैं उसका कोई भी दुष्कर्म फलदायी नहीं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जो मनुष्य महाराज पृथुके इस चरित्रका कीर्तन करता हैं उसका कोई भी दुष्कर्म फलदायी नहीं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न चिन्त्यं भवतः किंचिद् ध्रियते भूपतिः पिता न चैवेष्टवियोगादि तव पश्याम बालक
verses.transliteration: na cintyaṃ bhavataḥ kiṃcid dhriyate bhūpatiḥ pitā na caiveṣṭaviyogādi tava paśyāma bālaka
verses.hindi: ऋषि बोले— राजकुमार! अभी तो तू चार-पाँच वर्षका ही बालक है। अभी तेरे निर्वेदका कोई कारण नहीं दिखायी पड़ता
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: उनका प्रभाव अपने सुननेवाले पुरुषोंके दुःस्वप्नोंको सर्वदा शान्त कर देता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: उनका प्रभाव अपने सुननेवाले पुरुषोंके दुःस्वप्नोंको सर्वदा शान्त कर देता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शरीरे न च ते व्याधिर् अस्माभिर् उपलक्ष्यते निर्वेदः किंनिमित्तस् ते कथ्यतां यदि विद्यते
verses.transliteration: śarīre na ca te vyādhir asmābhir upalakṣyate nirvedaḥ kiṃnimittas te kathyatāṃ yadi vidyate
verses.hindi: तुझे कोई चिन्ताका विषय भी नहीं है, क्योंकि अभी तेरा पिता राजा जीवित है और हे बालक! तेरी कोई इष्ट वस्तु खो गयी हो ऐसा भी हमें दिखायी नहीं देता
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: पिता माने गये हैं; जैसे कहा है--। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पिता माने गये हैं; जैसे कहा है--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स कथयाम् आस सुरुच्या यद् उदाहृतम् तन् निशम्य ततः प्रोचुर् मुनयस् ते परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa kathayām āsa surucyā yad udāhṛtam tan niśamya tataḥ procur munayas te parasparam
verses.hindi: तथा हमें तेरे शरीरमें भी कोई व्याधि नहीं दीख पड़ती फिर बता, तेरी ग्लानिका क्या कारण है?
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: हे मुने ! उनके समयमें यज्ञानुष्ठानकी अधिकताके कारण प्राचीनाग्र कुश समस्त पृथिवीमें फैले हुए थे, इसलिये वे महाबली 'प्राचीनबर्हि' नामसे विख्यात हुए। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: हे मुने ! उनके समयमें यज्ञानुष्ठानकी अधिकताके कारण प्राचीनाग्र कुश समस्त पृथिवीमें फैले हुए थे, इसलिये वे महाबली 'प्राचीनबर्हि' नामसे विख्यात हुए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहो क्षात्रं परं तेजो बालस्यापि यद् अक्षमा सपत्न्या मातुर् उक्तस्य हृदयान् नापसर्पति
verses.transliteration: aho kṣātraṃ paraṃ tejo bālasyāpi yad akṣamā sapatnyā mātur uktasya hṛdayān nāpasarpati
verses.hindi: श्रीपराशरजी बोले— तब सुरुचिने उससे जो कुछ कहा था वह सब उसने कह सुनाया। उसे सुनकर वे ऋषिगण आपसमें इस प्रकार कहने लगे
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: हे महामते ! उन महीपतिने महान् तपस्याके अनन्तर समुद्रकी पुत्री सवर्णासा विवाह किया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: हे महामते ! उन महीपतिने महान् तपस्याके अनन्तर समुद्रकी पुत्री सवर्णासा विवाह किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भो भोः क्षत्रियदायाद निर्वेदाद् यत् त्वयाधुना कर्तुं व्यवसितं तन् नः कथ्यतां यदि रोचते
verses.transliteration: bho bhoḥ kṣatriyadāyāda nirvedād yat tvayādhunā kartuṃ vyavasitaṃ tan naḥ kathyatāṃ yadi rocate
verses.hindi: ‘अहो! क्षात्रतेज कैसा प्रबल है, जिससे बालकमें भी इतनी अक्षमा है कि अपनी विमाताका कथन उसके हृदयसे नहीं टलता’
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: नामक सभी पुत्र धनुर्विद्याके पारगामी थे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: नामक सभी पुत्र धनुर्विद्याके पारगामी थे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यच् च कार्यं तवास्माभिः साहाय्यम् अमितद्युते तद् उच्यतां विवक्षुस् त्वम् अस्माभिर् उपलक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration: yac ca kāryaṃ tavāsmābhiḥ sāhāyyam amitadyute tad ucyatāṃ vivakṣus tvam asmābhir upalakṣyase
verses.hindi: हे क्षत्रियकुमार! इस निर्वेदके कारण तूने जो कुछ करनेका निश्चय किया है, यदि तुझे रुचे तो, वह हमलोगोंसे कह दे
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: समुद्रके जलमें रहकर दस हजार वर्षतक समान धर्मका आचरण करते हुए घोर तपस्या की। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: समुद्रके जलमें रहकर दस हजार वर्षतक समान धर्मका आचरण करते हुए घोर तपस्या की। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: नाहम् अर्थम् अभीप्सामि न राज्यं द्विजसत्तमाः तत् स्थानम् एकम् इच्छामि भुक्तं नान्येन यत् पुरा
verses.transliteration: nāham artham abhīpsāmi na rājyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ tat sthānam ekam icchāmi bhuktaṃ nānyena yat purā
verses.hindi: और हे अतुलित तेजस्वी! यह भी बता कि हम तेरी क्या सहायता करें, क्योंकि हमें ऐसा प्रतीत होता है कि तू कुछ कहना चाहता है
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: श्रीमैत्रेयजी बोले--हे महामुने! उन महात्मा प्रचेताओंने जिस लिये समुद्रके जलमें तपस्या की थी। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: श्रीमैत्रेयजी बोले--हे महामुने! उन महात्मा प्रचेताओंने जिस लिये समुद्रके जलमें तपस्या की थी। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतन् मे क्रियतां सम्यक् कथ्यतां प्राप्यते यथा स्थानम् अग्र्यं समस्तेभ्यः स्थानेभ्यो मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: etan me kriyatāṃ samyak kathyatāṃ prāpyate yathā sthānam agryaṃ samastebhyaḥ sthānebhyo munisattamāḥ
verses.hindi: ध्रुवने कहा— हे द्विजश्रेष्ठ! मुझे न तो धनकी इच्छा है और न राज्यकी; मैं तो केवल एक उसी स्थानको चाहता हूँ जिसको पहले कभी किसीने न भोगा हो
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: श्रीपराशरजी कहने लगे--हे मैत्रेय! एक बार। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: श्रीपराशरजी कहने लगे--हे मैत्रेय! एक बार। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनाराधितगोविन्दैर् नरैः स्थानं नृपात्मज न हि संप्राप्यते श्रेष्ठं तस्माद् आराधयाच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: anārādhitagovindair naraiḥ sthānaṃ nṛpātmaja na hi saṃprāpyate śreṣṭhaṃ tasmād ārādhayācyutam
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ! आपकी यही सहायता होगी कि आप मुझे भली प्रकार यह बता दें कि क्या करनेसे वह सबसे अग्रगण्य स्थान प्राप्त हो सकता है
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: मुझे आज्ञा दी है कि तुम प्रजाकी वृद्धि करो ' और मैंने भी उनसे ' बहुत अच्छा ' कह दिया है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: परः पराणां पुरुषो यस्य तुष्टो जनार्दनः स प्राप्नोत्य् अक्षयं स्थानम् एतत् सत्यं मयोदितम्
verses.transliteration: paraḥ parāṇāṃ puruṣo yasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ sa prāpnoty akṣayaṃ sthānam etat satyaṃ mayoditam
verses.hindi: मरीचि बोले— हे राजपुत्र! बिना गोविन्दकी आराधना किये मनुष्यको वह श्रेष्ठ स्थान नहीं मिल सकता; अत: तू श्रीअच्युतकी आराधना कर
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."

verses.science: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--हे मुने! उन राजकुमारोंने पिताके ये वचन सुनकर उनसे “जो आज्ञा' ऐसा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्यान्तः सर्वम् एवेदम् अच्युतस्याव्ययात्मनः तम् आराधय गोविन्दं स्थानम् अग्र्यं यदीच्छसि
verses.transliteration: yasyāntaḥ sarvam evedam acyutasyāvyayātmanaḥ tam ārādhaya govindaṃ sthānam agryaṃ yadīcchasi
verses.hindi: अत्रि बोले— जो परा प्रकृति आदिसे भी परे हैं वे परमपुरुष जनार्दन जिससे सन्तुष्ट होते हैं उसीको वह अक्षयपद मिलता है यह मैं सत्य-सत्य कहता हूँ
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: प्रचेता बोले--हे तात! जिस कर्मसे हम प्रजा- वृद्धिमें समर्थ हो सर्कें उसकी आप हमसे भली प्रकार व्याख्या कीजिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: प्रचेता बोले--हे तात! जिस कर्मसे हम प्रजा- वृद्धिमें समर्थ हो सर्कें उसकी आप हमसे भली प्रकार व्याख्या कीजिये। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम यो ऽसौ ब्रह्म तथा परम् तम् आराध्य हरिं याति मुक्तिम् अप्य् अतिदुर्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma yo 'sau brahma tathā param tam ārādhya hariṃ yāti muktim apy atidurlabhām
verses.hindi: अंगिरा बोले— यदि तू अग््रयस्थानका इच्छुक है तो जिन अव्ययात्मा अच्युतमें यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् ओतप्रोत है, उन गोविन्दकी ही आराधना कर
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: आराधनीयो भगवाननादिपुरुषोत्तम ॥ १६ नारायणे मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वलोकपरायणे॥ १९ भुज्यते5नुदिनं देव: पितृभिश्च सुधात्मक:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: आराधनीयो भगवाननादिपुरुषोत्तम ॥ १६ नारायणे मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वलोकपरायणे॥ १९ भुज्यते5नुदिनं देव: पितृभिश्च सुधात्मक:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यो यज्ञपुरुषो यज्ञे योगे यः परमः पुमान् तस्मिंस् तुष्टे यद् अप्राप्यं किं तद् अस्ति जनार्दने
verses.transliteration: yo yajñapuruṣo yajñe yoge yaḥ paramaḥ pumān tasmiṃs tuṣṭe yad aprāpyaṃ kiṃ tad asti janārdane
verses.hindi: पुलस्त्य बोले— जो परब्रह्म, परमधाम और परस्वरूप हैं, उन हरिकी आराधना करनेसे मनुष्य अति दुर्लभ मोक्षपदको भी प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: इसलिये यदि तुम सफलता गोविन्दकी उपासना करो। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: इसलिये यदि तुम सफलता गोविन्दकी उपासना करो। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रम् इन्द्रः परं स्थानं यम् आराध्य जगत्पतिम् प्राप यज्ञपतिं विष्णुं तम् आराधय सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: aindram indraḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ yam ārādhya jagatpatim prāpa yajñapatiṃ viṣṇuṃ tam ārādhaya suvrata

verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."

verses.science: धर्म, अर्थ, काम या विष्णुकी ही आराधना करनी चाहिये। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोष्य् आराधिते विष्णौ मनसा यद् यद् इच्छसि त्रैलोक्यान्तर्गतं स्थानं किम् उ वत्सोत्तमोत्तमम् कृष्णाराधनम् एवैकं पुंसः सर्वफलप्रदम् सर्वैर् अप्य् एवम् एवोक्तं तद् उपायम् अबृहत् सते
verses.transliteration: prāpnoṣy ārādhite viṣṇau manasā yad yad icchasi trailokyāntargataṃ sthānaṃ kim u vatsottamottamam kṛṣṇārādhanam evaikaṃ puṃsaḥ sarvaphalapradam sarvair apy evam evoktaṃ tad upāyam abṛhat sate
verses.hindi: क्रतु बोले— जो परमपुरुष यज्ञपुरुष, यज्ञ और योगेश्वर हैं, उन जनार्दनके सन्तुष्ट होनेपर कौन-सी वस्तु दुर्लभ रह सकती है?
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."

verses.science: आरम्भमें जिनकी उपासना करके प्रजापतिने संसारको रचना की है, तुम उन अच्युतकी ही आराधना करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आराध्यः कथितो देवो भवद्भिः प्रणतस्य मे मया तत्परितोषाय यज् जप्तव्यं तद् उच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhyaḥ kathito devo bhavadbhiḥ praṇatasya me mayā tatparitoṣāya yaj japtavyaṃ tad ucyatām
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठ बोले— हे वत्स! विष्णुभगवान्‌की आराधना करनेपर तू अपने मनसे जो कुछ चाहेगा वही प्राप्त कर लेगा, फिर त्रिलोकीके उत्तमोत्तम स्थानकी तो बात ही क्या है?
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. verses.science: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--पिताकी ऐसी आज्ञा होनेपर प्रचेता नामक दसों पुत्रोंने समुद्रके जलमें डूबे रहकर सावधानतापूर्वक तप करना आरम्भ कर दिया। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा चाराधनं तस्य मया कार्यं महात्मनः प्रसादसुमुखास् तन् मे कथयन्तु महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: yathā cārādhanaṃ tasya mayā kāryaṃ mahātmanaḥ prasādasumukhās tan me kathayantu maharṣayaḥ

verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."
verses.explanation: लगाये हुए उन्होंने दस हजार वर्षतक वहीं (जलमें की, जो अपनी स्तुति की जानेपर स्तुति करनेवालोंकी सभी कामनाएँ सफल कर देते हैं॥१९-२०॥ पवित्र स्तुति की थी वह कृपया…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: लगाये हुए उन्होंने दस हजार वर्षतक वहीं (जलमें की, जो अपनी स्तुति की जानेपर स्तुति करनेवालोंकी सभी कामनाएँ सफल कर देते हैं॥१९-२०॥ पवित्र स्तुति की थी वह कृपया…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: राजपुत्र यथा विष्णोर् आराधनपरैर् नरैः कार्यम् आराधनं तन् नो यथावच् छ्रोतुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: rājaputra yathā viṣṇor ārādhanaparair naraiḥ kāryam ārādhanaṃ tan no yathāvac chrotum arhasi
verses.translation: their minds from all exlerior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrat?d his Ihoughts on onc only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. ' Om, salutation to Vasudcva, who is manifest as Ðrajima, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable. This pray was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayam- blmva, and propitiated by which, Janardana conferred upon him prosperity, which he dcsired, unequalled in three wejlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually."

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यार्थाद् अखिलाच् चित्तं त्याजयेत् प्रथमं नरः तस्मिन्न् एव जगद्धाम्नि ततः कुर्वीत निश्चलम्

verses.sanskrit: एवम् एकाग्रचित्तेन तन्मयेन धृतात्मना जप्तव्यं यन् निबोधैतत् तन् नः पार्थिवनन्दन

verses.science: जो प्राण, अपान आदि पाँच प्रकारसे देहमें स्थित होकर दिन-रात चेष्टा करता रहता है तथा जिसकी योनि आकाश है, उस वायुरूप भगवान्को नमस्कार। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतकृत्यम् इवात्मानं मन्यमानस् ततो द्विज मधुसंज्ञं महापुण्यं जगाम यमुनातटम्

verses.science: जो समस्त भूतोंको अवकाश देता है उस। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनश् च मधुसंज्ञेन दैत्येनाधिष्ठितं यतः ततो मधुवनं नाम्ना ख्यातम् अत्र महीतले

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा च लवणं रक्षो मधुपुत्रं महाबलम् शत्रुघ्नो मधुरां नाम पुरीं यत्र चकार वै
