verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभ्यस् तु सहस्राणां शताद् ऊर्ध्वं व्यवस्थितः मेढीभूतः समस्तस्य ज्योतिश्चक्रस्य वै ध्रुवः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhyas tu sahasrāṇāṃ śatād ūrdhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ meḍhībhūtaḥ samastasya jyotiścakrasya vai dhruvaḥ
verses.hindi: तथा सप्तर्षियोंसे भी सौ हजार योजन ऊपर समस्त ज्योतिश्चक्रकी नाभिरूप ध्रुवमण्डल स्थित है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: तदाधारं जगच्चेद॑ सदेवासुरमानुषम्॥ ७ विवस्वानष्टभिमासिरादायापो रसात्मिका:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तदाधारं जगच्चेद॑ सदेवासुरमानुषम्॥ ७ विवस्वानष्टभिमासिरादायापो रसात्मिका:। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यम् एतत् कथितम् उत्सेधेन महामुने इज्याफलस्य भूर् एषा इज्या चात्र प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: trailokyam etat kathitam utsedhena mahāmune ijyāphalasya bhūr eṣā ijyā cātra pratiṣṭhitā
verses.hindi: हे महामुने! मैंने तुमसे यह त्रिलोकीकी उच्चताके विषयमें वर्णन किया। यह त्रिलोकी यज्ञफलकी भोग-भूमि है और यज्ञानुष्ठानकी स्थिति इस भारतवर्षमें ही है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: मैंने तुमसे आकाशमें ग्रहगणके जिस शिशुमार- भगवान् नारायण ही उसके हृदयस्थित आधार हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: मैंने तुमसे आकाशमें ग्रहगणके जिस शिशुमार- भगवान् नारायण ही उसके हृदयस्थित आधार हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवाद् ऊर्ध्वं महर्लोको यत्र ते कल्पवासिनः एकयोजनकोटी तु महर्लोको ऽभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: dhruvād ūrdhvaṃ maharloko yatra te kalpavāsinaḥ ekayojanakoṭī tu maharloko 'bhidhīyate
verses.hindi: ध्रुवसे एक करोड़ योजन ऊपर महर्लोक है, जहाँ कल्पान्त-पर्यन्त रहनेवाले भृगु आदि सिद्धगण रहते हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: जिस प्रकार देव, असुर और मनुष्यादिके सहित यह सूर्य आठ मासतक अपनी किरणोंसे छ: रसोंसे युक्त जलको ग्रहण करके उसे चार महीनोंमें बरसा देता है उससे संसारका जल खींचक…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जिस प्रकार देव, असुर और मनुष्यादिके सहित यह सूर्य आठ मासतक अपनी किरणोंसे छ: रसोंसे युक्त जलको ग्रहण करके उसे चार महीनोंमें बरसा देता है उससे संसारका जल खींचक…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वे कोटी तु जनो लोको यत्र ते ब्रह्मणः सुताः सनन्दनाद्याः कथिता मैत्रेयामलचेतसः
verses.transliteration: dve koṭī tu jano loko yatra te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ sanandanādyāḥ kathitā maitreyāmalacetasaḥ
verses.hindi: हे मैत्रेय! उससे भी दो करोड़ योजन ऊपर जनलोक है जिसमें ब्रह्माजीके प्रख्यात पुत्र निर्मलचित्त सनकादि रहते हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: होता इसलिये 'अभ्र' कहलाता हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: होता इसलिये 'अभ्र' कहलाता हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्गुणोत्तरे चोर्ध्वं जनलोकात् तपः स्मृतः वैराजा यत्र ते देवाः स्थिता दाहविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: caturguṇottare cordhvaṃ janalokāt tapaḥ smṛtaḥ vairājā yatra te devāḥ sthitā dāhavivarjitāḥ
verses.hindi: जनलोकसे चौगुना अर्थात् आठ करोड़ योजन ऊपर तपलोक है; वहाँ वैराज नामक देवगणोंका निवास है जिनका कभी दाह नहीं होता
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: हे मुने! भगवान् सूर्यदेव नदी, समुद्र, पृथिवी तथा। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: हे मुने! भगवान् सूर्यदेव नदी, समुद्र, पृथिवी तथा। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: षड्गुणेन तपोलोकात् सत्यलोको विराजते अपुनर्मारका यत्र ब्रह्मलोको हि स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍguṇena tapolokāt satyaloko virājate apunarmārakā yatra brahmaloko hi sa smṛtaḥ
verses.hindi: तपलोकसे छ:गुना अर्थात् बारह करोड़ योजनके अन्तरपर सत्यलोक सुशोभित है जो ब्रह्मलोक भी कहलाता है और जिसमें फिर न मरनेवाले अमरगण निवास करते हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: तथा आकाशगंगाके जलको ग्रहण करके वे उसे बिना मेघादिक अपनी किरणोंसे ही तुरन्त पृथिवीपर। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तथा आकाशगंगाके जलको ग्रहण करके वे उसे बिना मेघादिक अपनी किरणोंसे ही तुरन्त पृथिवीपर। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पादगम्यं तु यत् किंचिद् वस्त्व् अस्ति पृथिवीमयम् स भूर्लोकः समाख्यातो विस्तरो ऽस्य मयोदितः
verses.transliteration: pādagamyaṃ tu yat kiṃcid vastv asti pṛthivīmayam sa bhūrlokaḥ samākhyāto vistaro 'sya mayoditaḥ
verses.hindi: जो भी पार्थिव वस्तु चरणसंचारके योग्य है वह भूर्लोक ही है। उसका विस्तार मैं कह चुका
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: पाप-पंकके धुल जानेसे मनुष्य नरकमें नहीं जाता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पाप-पंकके धुल जानेसे मनुष्य नरकमें नहीं जाता। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूमिसूर्यान्तरं यत् तु सिद्धादिमुनिसेवितम् भुवर्लोकस् तु सो ऽप्य् उक्तो द्वितीयो मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhūmisūryāntaraṃ yat tu siddhādimunisevitam bhuvarlokas tu so 'py ukto dvitīyo munisattama
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ! पृथिवी और सूर्यके मध्यमें जो सिद्धगण और मुनिगण-सेवित स्थान है, वही दूसरा भुवर्लोक है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: देते हुए, बिना मेघोंके ही जो जल बरसता है वह सूर्यकी किरणोंद्वारा बरसाया हुआ आकाशगंगाका ही जल होता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: देते हुए, बिना मेघोंके ही जो जल बरसता है वह सूर्यकी किरणोंद्वारा बरसाया हुआ आकाशगंगाका ही जल होता। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवसूर्यान्तरं यत् तु नियुतानि चतुर्दश स्वर्लोकः सो ऽपि गदितो लोकसंस्थानचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: dhruvasūryāntaraṃ yat tu niyutāni caturdaśa svarlokaḥ so 'pi gadito lokasaṃsthānacintakaiḥ
verses.hindi: सूर्य और ध्रुवके बीचमें जो चौदह लक्ष योजनका अन्तर है, उसीको लोकस्थितिका विचार करनेवालोंने स्वर्लोक कहा है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: बरसाया हुआ आकाशगंगाका जल समझना चाहिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: बरसाया हुआ आकाशगंगाका जल समझना चाहिये। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यम् एतत् कृतकं मैत्रेय परिपठ्यते जनस् तपस् तथा सत्यम् इति चाकृतकं त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: trailokyam etat kṛtakaṃ maitreya paripaṭhyate janas tapas tathā satyam iti cākṛtakaṃ trayam
verses.hindi: हे मैत्रेय! ये (भू:, भुव:, स्व:) ‘कृतक’ त्रैलोक्य कहलाते हैं और जन, तप तथा सत्य—ये तीनों ‘अकृतक’ लोक हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: आकाशगंगासे ग्रहण करके ही बरसाया जाता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: आकाशगंगासे ग्रहण करके ही बरसाया जाता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतकाकृतयोर् मध्ये महर्लोक इति स्मृतः शून्यो भवति कल्पान्ते यो ऽत्यन्तं न विनश्यति
verses.transliteration: kṛtakākṛtayor madhye maharloka iti smṛtaḥ śūnyo bhavati kalpānte yo 'tyantaṃ na vinaśyati
verses.hindi: इन कृतक और अकृतक त्रिलोकियोंके मध्यमें महर्लोक कहा जाता है, जो कल्पान्तमें केवल जनशून्य हो जाता है, अत्यन्त नष्ट नहीं होता [इसलिये यह ‘कृतकाकृत’ कहलाता है]
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: हे महामुने! आकाशगंगाके ये सम तथा विषम नक्षत्रोंमें पवित्र और मनुष्योंके पाप-भयको दूर करनेवाले हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: हे महामुने! आकाशगंगाके ये सम तथा विषम नक्षत्रोंमें पवित्र और मनुष्योंके पाप-भयको दूर करनेवाले हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्त मया लोका मैत्रेय कथितास् तव पातालानि च सप्तैव ब्रह्माण्डस्यैष विस्तरः
verses.transliteration: ete sapta mayā lokā maitreya kathitās tava pātālāni ca saptaiva brahmāṇḍasyaiṣa vistaraḥ
verses.hindi: हे मैत्रेय! इस प्रकार मैंने तुमसे ये सात लोक और सात ही पाताल कहे। इस ब्रह्माण्डका बस इतना ही विस्तार है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: साधक: फलपाकान्तः प्रजानां द्विज जायते॥ १९ आधारभूत: सवितुर्शुवोी मुनिवरोत्तम। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: साधक: फलपाकान्तः प्रजानां द्विज जायते॥ १९ आधारभूत: सवितुर्शुवोी मुनिवरोत्तम। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद् अण्डकटाहेन तिर्यक् चोर्ध्वम् अधस् तथा कपित्थस्य यथा बीजं सर्वतो वै समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: etad aṇḍakaṭāhena tiryak cordhvam adhas tathā kapitthasya yathā bījaṃ sarvato vai samāvṛtam
verses.hindi: यह ब्रह्माण्ड कपित्थ (कैथे)-के बीजके समान ऊपर-नीचे सब ओर अण्डकटाहसे घिरा हुआ है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: करके देवताओंको सन्तुष्ट करते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: करके देवताओंको सन्तुष्ट करते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दशोत्तरेण पयसा मैत्रेयाण्डं च तद् वृतम् सर्वो ऽम्बुपरिधानो ऽसौ वह्निना वेष्टितो बहिः
verses.transliteration: daśottareṇa payasā maitreyāṇḍaṃ ca tad vṛtam sarvo 'mbuparidhāno 'sau vahninā veṣṭito bahiḥ
verses.hindi: हे मैत्रेय! यह अण्ड अपनेसे दसगुने जलसे आवृत है और वह जलका सम्पूर्ण आवरण अग्निसे घिरा हुआ है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: और प्राणिगण वृष्टिके ही आश्रित हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: और प्राणिगण वृष्टिके ही आश्रित हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: वह्निश् च वायुना वायुर् मैत्रेय नभसा वृतः भूतादिना नभः सो ऽपि महता परिवेष्टितः दशोत्तराण्य् अशेषाणि मैत्रेयैतानि सप्त वै
verses.transliteration: vahniś ca vāyunā vāyur maitreya nabhasā vṛtaḥ bhūtādinā nabhaḥ so 'pi mahatā pariveṣṭitaḥ daśottarāṇy aśeṣāṇi maitreyaitāni sapta vai
verses.hindi: अग्नि वायुसे और वायु आकाशसे परिवेष्टित है तथा आकाश भूतोंके कारण तामस अहंकार और अहंकार महत्तत्त्वसे घिरा हुआ है। हे मैत्रेय! ये सातों उत्तरोत्तर एक-दूसरेसे दसगुने हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: सबको धारण करती है तथा उस वृष्टिकी उत्पत्ति। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सबको धारण करती है तथा उस वृष्टिकी उत्पत्ति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महान्तं च समावृत्य प्रधानं समवस्थितम् अनन्तस्य न तस्यान्तः संख्यानं वापि विद्यते
verses.transliteration: mahāntaṃ ca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ samavasthitam anantasya na tasyāntaḥ saṃkhyānaṃ vāpi vidyate
verses.hindi: महत्तत्त्वको भी प्रधानने आवृत कर रखा है। वह अनन्त है; तथा उसका न कभी अन्त (नाश) होता है और न कोई संख्या ही है; क्योंकि हे मुने! वह अनन्त, असंख्येय, अपरिमेय और सम्पूर्ण जगत‍्का कारण है और वही परा प्रकृति है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: है तथा शिशुमारके आश्रय श्रीनारायण हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: है तथा शिशुमारके आश्रय श्रीनारायण हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद् अनन्तम् असंख्यातप्रमाणं चापि वै यतः हेतुभूतम् अशेषस्य प्रकृतिः सा परा मुने
verses.transliteration: tad anantam asaṃkhyātapramāṇaṃ cāpi vai yataḥ hetubhūtam aśeṣasya prakṛtiḥ sā parā mune
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: शिशुमारके हृदयमें श्रीनारायण स्थित हैं जो समस्त प्राणियोंक पालनकर्ता तथा आदिभूत सनातन पुरुष हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: शिशुमारके हृदयमें श्रीनारायण स्थित हैं जो समस्त प्राणियोंक पालनकर्ता तथा आदिभूत सनातन पुरुष हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अण्डानां तु सहस्राणां सहस्राण्य् अयुतानि च ईदृशानां तथा तत्र कोटिकोटिशतानि च
verses.transliteration: aṇḍānāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇy ayutāni ca īdṛśānāṃ tathā tatra koṭikoṭiśatāni ca
verses.hindi: उसमें ऐसे-ऐसे हजारों, लाखों तथा सैकड़ों करोड़ ब्रह्माण्ड हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: द्वादश सूर्योके नाम एवं अधिकारियोंका वर्णन स रथो5धिष्ठितो देवैरादित्येऋषिभिस्तथा। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: द्वादश सूर्योके नाम एवं अधिकारियोंका वर्णन स रथो5धिष्ठितो देवैरादित्येऋषिभिस्तथा। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुण्य् अग्निर् यथा तैलं तिले तद्वत् पुमान् अपि प्रधाने ऽवस्थितो व्यापी चेतनात्मात्मवेदनः
verses.transliteration: dāruṇy agnir yathā tailaṃ tile tadvat pumān api pradhāne 'vasthito vyāpī cetanātmātmavedanaḥ
verses.hindi: जिस प्रकार काष्ठमें अग्नि और तिलमें तैल रहता है उसी प्रकार स्वप्रकाश चेतनात्मा व्यापक पुरुष प्रधानमें स्थित है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: सूर्यका रथ प्रति मास सर्प और राक्षसगणोंसे अधिष्ठित होता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सूर्यका रथ प्रति मास सर्प और राक्षसगणोंसे अधिष्ठित होता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं च पुमांश् चैव सर्वभूतात्मभूतया विष्णुशक्त्या महाबुद्धे वृतौ संश्रयधर्मिणौ
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ ca pumāṃś caiva sarvabhūtātmabhūtayā viṣṇuśaktyā mahābuddhe vṛtau saṃśrayadharmiṇau
verses.hindi: हे महाबुद्धे! ये संश्रयशील (आपसमें मिले हुए) प्रधान और पुरुष भी समस्त भूतोंकी स्वरूपभूता विष्णु-शक्तिसे आवृत हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: गन्धर्व--ये सात मासाधिकारी रहते हैं॥३-४॥ तथा और नारद नामक गन्धर्व--ये वैशाख-मासमें सूर्यके रथपर निवास करते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: गन्धर्व--ये सात मासाधिकारी रहते हैं॥३-४॥ तथा और नारद नामक गन्धर्व--ये वैशाख-मासमें सूर्यके रथपर निवास करते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तयोः सैव पृथग्भावकारणं संश्रयस्य च क्षोभकारणभूता च सर्गकाले महामते
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ saiva pṛthagbhāvakāraṇaṃ saṃśrayasya ca kṣobhakāraṇabhūtā ca sargakāle mahāmate
verses.hindi: हे महामते! वह विष्णु-शक्ति ही [प्रलयके समय] उनके पार्थक्य और [स्थितिके समय] उनके सम्मिलनकी हेतु है तथा सर्गारम्भके समय वही उनके क्षोभकी कारण है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: तथा आषाढ़-मासमें वरुण नामक आदित्य, वसिष्ठ ऋषि, रथचित्र नामक यक्ष उसमें रहते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तथा आषाढ़-मासमें वरुण नामक आदित्य, वसिष्ठ ऋषि, रथचित्र नामक यक्ष उसमें रहते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा सक्तं जले वातो बिभर्ति कणिकाशतम् शक्तिः सापि तथा विष्णोः प्रधानपुरुषात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: yathā saktaṃ jale vāto bibharti kaṇikāśatam śaktiḥ sāpi tathā viṣṇoḥ pradhānapuruṣātmakam
verses.hindi: जिस प्रकार जलके संसर्गसे वायु सैकड़ों जल-कणोंको धारण करता है उसी प्रकार भगवान् विष्णुकी शक्ति भी प्रधान-पुरुषमय जगत‍्को धारण करती है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: और सर्पि नामक राक्षस सूर्यके रथमें बसते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: और सर्पि नामक राक्षस सूर्यके रथमें बसते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा च पादपो मूलस्कन्धशाखादिसंयुतः आदिबीजात् प्रभवति बीजान्य् अन्यानि वै ततः
verses.transliteration: yathā ca pādapo mūlaskandhaśākhādisaṃyutaḥ ādibījāt prabhavati bījāny anyāni vai tataḥ
verses.hindi: हे मुने! जिस प्रकार आदि-बीजसे ही मूल, स्कन्ध और शाखा आदिके सहित वृक्ष उत्पन्न होता है और तदनन्तर उससे और भी बीज उत्पन्न होते हैं, तथा उन बीजोंसे अन्यान्य वृक्ष उत्पन्न होते हैं और वे भी उन्हीं लक्षण, द्रव्य और कारणोंसे युक्त होते हैं , उसी प्रकार पहले अव्याकृत (प्रधान)-से महत्तत्त्वसे लेकर पंचभूतपर्यन्त [सम्पूर्ण विकार] उत्पन्न होते हैं तथा उनसे देव, असुर आदिका जन्म होता है और फिर उनके पुत्र तथा उन पुत्रोंके अन्य पुत्र होते हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: और व्याप्र नामक राक्षसका उसमें निवास होता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: और व्याप्र नामक राक्षसका उसमें निवास होता है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रभवन्ति ततस् तेभ्यः संभवन्त्य् अपरे द्रुमाः ते ऽपि तल्लक्षणद्रव्यकारणानुगता मुने
verses.transliteration: prabhavanti tatas tebhyaḥ saṃbhavanty apare drumāḥ te 'pi tallakṣaṇadravyakāraṇānugatā mune
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: घृताची नामकी अप्सराका उसमें वास होता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: घृताची नामकी अप्सराका उसमें वास होता है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अव्याकृतात् पूर्वं जायन्ते महदादयः विशेषान्तास् ततस् तेभ्यः संभवन्ति सुरादयः तेभ्यश् च पुत्रास् तेषां च पुत्राणाम् अपरे सुताः
verses.transliteration: evam avyākṛtāt pūrvaṃ jāyante mahadādayaḥ viśeṣāntās tatas tebhyaḥ saṃbhavanti surādayaḥ tebhyaś ca putrās teṣāṃ ca putrāṇām apare sutāḥ
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: सेनजित् यक्ष तथा आप नामक राक्षस रहते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सेनजित् यक्ष तथा आप नामक राक्षस रहते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: बीजाद् वृक्षप्ररोहेण यथा नापचयस् तरोः भूतानां भूतसर्गेण नैवास्त्य् अपचयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: bījād vṛkṣapraroheṇa yathā nāpacayas taroḥ bhūtānāṃ bhūtasargeṇa naivāsty apacayas tathā
verses.hindi: अपने बीजसे अन्य वृक्षके उत्पन्न होनेसे जिस प्रकार पूर्ववृक्षकी कोई क्षति नहीं होती उसी प्रकार अन्य प्राणियोंके उत्पन्न होनेसे उनके जन्मदाता प्राणियोंका हृस नहीं होता
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: रथमें रहते हैं उनके नाम सुनो ॥ १६-१७ ॥ है महामुने ! वे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: रथमें रहते हैं उनके नाम सुनो ॥ १६-१७ ॥ है महामुने ! वे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: संनिधानाद् यथाकाशकालाद्याः कारणं तरोः तथैवापरिणामेन विश्वस्य भगवान् हरिः
verses.transliteration: saṃnidhānād yathākāśakālādyāḥ kāraṇaṃ taroḥ tathaivāpariṇāmena viśvasya bhagavān hariḥ
verses.hindi: जिस प्रकार आकाश और काल आदि सन्निधिमात्रसे ही वृक्षके कारण होते हैं उसी प्रकार भगवान् श्रीहरि भी बिना परिणामके ही विश्वके कारण हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: हुए ये सात-सात गण एक-एक मासतक सूर्यमण्डलमें रहते। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: हुए ये सात-सात गण एक-एक मासतक सूर्यमण्डलमें रहते। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रीहिबीजे यथा मूलं नालं पत्राङ्कुरौ तथा काण्डकोषस् तथा पुष्पं क्षीरं तद्वच् च तण्डुलाः
verses.transliteration: vrīhibīje yathā mūlaṃ nālaṃ patrāṅkurau tathā kāṇḍakoṣas tathā puṣpaṃ kṣīraṃ tadvac ca taṇḍulāḥ
verses.hindi: हे मुनिसत्तम! जिस प्रकार धानके बीजमें मूल, नाल, पत्ते, अंकुर, तना, कोष, पुष्प, क्षीर, तण्डुल, तुष और कण सभी रहते हैं; तथा अंकुरोत्पत्तिकी हेतुभूत [ भूमि एवं जल आदि] सामग्रीके प्राप्त होनेपर वे प्रकट हो जाते हैं, उसी प्रकार अपने अनेक पूर्वकर्मोंमें स्थित देवता आदि विष्णु-शक्तिका आश्रय पानेपर आविर्भूत हो जाते हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: उनका यशोगान करते हैं, अप्सराएँ नृत्य करती हैं, राक्षस रथके पीछे चलते हैं, सर्प वहन करनेके अनुकूल रथको सुसज्जित करते हैं और यक्षणण रथकी बागडोर सँभालते हैं तथा…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: उनका यशोगान करते हैं, अप्सराएँ नृत्य करती हैं, राक्षस रथके पीछे चलते हैं, सर्प वहन करनेके अनुकूल रथको सुसज्जित करते हैं और यक्षणण रथकी बागडोर सँभालते हैं तथा…। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुषाः कणाश् च सन्तो वै यान्त्य् आविर्भावम् आत्मनः प्ररोहहेतुसामग्रीम् आसाद्य मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tuṣāḥ kaṇāś ca santo vai yānty āvirbhāvam ātmanaḥ prarohahetusāmagrīm āsādya munisattama
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: श्रीमैत्रेयजी बोले--भगवन्! आपने जो कहा कारण होते हैं, सो मैंने सुना। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: श्रीमैत्रेयजी बोले--भगवन्! आपने जो कहा कारण होते हैं, सो मैंने सुना। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा कर्मस्व् अनेकेषु देवाद्याः समवस्थिताः विष्णुशक्तिं समासाद्य प्ररोहम् उपयान्ति वै
verses.transliteration: tathā karmasv anekeṣu devādyāḥ samavasthitāḥ viṣṇuśaktiṃ samāsādya praroham upayānti vai
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: तो पृथक्-पृथक् व्यापार बतलाये, किंतु है मुने! यह नहीं बतलाया कि सूर्यका कार्य क्‍या है?॥ २-३॥ यदि सातों गण ही शीत, ग्रीष्म और वर्षके करनेवाले हैं तो फिर सूर्…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तो पृथक्-पृथक् व्यापार बतलाये, किंतु है मुने! यह नहीं बतलाया कि सूर्यका कार्य क्‍या है?॥ २-३॥ यदि सातों गण ही शीत, ग्रीष्म और वर्षके करनेवाले हैं तो फिर सूर्…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: स च विष्णुः परं ब्रह्म यतः सर्वम् इदं जगत् जगच् च यो यत्र चेदं यस्मिंश् च लयम् एष्यति
verses.transliteration: sa ca viṣṇuḥ paraṃ brahma yataḥ sarvam idaṃ jagat jagac ca yo yatra cedaṃ yasmiṃś ca layam eṣyati
verses.hindi: जिससे यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् उत्पन्न हुआ है, जो स्वयं जगत्रूपसे स्थित है, जिसमें यह स्थित है तथा जिसमें यह लीन हो जायगा वह परब्रह्म ही विष्णुभगवान् हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: सातों गणोंका यह वृष्टि आदि कार्य समान ही है तो 'सूर्य उदय हुआ, अब मध्यमें है, अब अस्त होता है” ऐसा लोग क्‍यों कहते हैं?। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सातों गणोंका यह वृष्टि आदि कार्य समान ही है तो 'सूर्य उदय हुआ, अब मध्यमें है, अब अस्त होता है” ऐसा लोग क्‍यों कहते हैं?। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद् ब्रह्म तत् परं धाम सदसत्परमं पदम् यस्य सर्वम् अभेदेन जगद् एतच् चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: tad brahma tat paraṃ dhāma sadasatparamaṃ padam yasya sarvam abhedena jagad etac carācaram
verses.hindi: वह ब्रह्म ही उन (विष्णु)-का परमधाम (परस्वरूप) है, वह पद सत् और असत् दोनोंसे विलक्षण है तथा उससे अभिन्न हुआ ही यह सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगत् उससे उत्पन्न हुआ है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--हे मैत्रेय! जो कुछ तुमने पूछा है उसका उत्तर सुनो, सूर्य सात गणोंमेंसे ही एक हैं तथापि उनमें प्रधान होनेसे उनकी विशेषता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: श्रीपराशरजी बोले--हे मैत्रेय! जो कुछ तुमने पूछा है उसका उत्तर सुनो, सूर्य सात गणोंमेंसे ही एक हैं तथापि उनमें प्रधान होनेसे उनकी विशेषता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स एव मूलप्रकृतिर् व्यक्तरूपी जगच् च सः तस्मिन्न् एव लयं सर्वं याति तत्र च तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sa eva mūlaprakṛtir vyaktarūpī jagac ca saḥ tasminn eva layaṃ sarvaṃ yāti tatra ca tiṣṭhati
verses.hindi: वही अव्यक्त मूलप्रकृति है, वही व्यक्तस्वरूप संसार है, उसीमें यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् लीन होता है तथा उसीके आश्रय स्थित है
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: नामकी परा शक्ति है वह वेदत्रयी ही सूर्यको ताप प्रदान करती है और उपासना किये जानेपर संसारके समस्त पापोंको नष्ट कर देती है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: नामकी परा शक्ति है वह वेदत्रयी ही सूर्यको ताप प्रदान करती है और उपासना किये जानेपर संसारके समस्त पापोंको नष्ट कर देती है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता क्रियाणां स च इज्यते क्रतुः स एव तत्कर्मफलं च तस्य यत् स्रुगादि यत् साधनम् अप्य् अशेषतो हरेर् न किंचिद् व्यतिरिक्तम् अस्ति वै
verses.transliteration: kartā kriyāṇāṃ sa ca ijyate kratuḥ sa eva tatkarmaphalaṃ ca tasya yat srugādi yat sādhanam apy aśeṣato harer na kiṃcid vyatiriktam asti vai
verses.hindi: यज्ञादि क्रियाओंका कर्ता वही है, यज्ञरूपसे उसीका यजन किया जाता है, और उन यज्ञादिका फलस्वरूप भी वही है तथा यज्ञके साधनरूप जो स्रुवा आदि हैं वे सब भी हरिसे अतिरिक्त और कुछ नहीं हैं
verses.translation: from whom the creation of the universe has proceedéd, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it wilt be dissolved. He is Brahma, the e xcellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice ; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celekrated. There is no other thing but Hari.
verses.explanation: जगतू्की स्थिति और पालनके लिये वे ऋक्, यजु: और सामरूप विष्णु सूर्यके भीतर निवास करते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जगतू्की स्थिति और पालनके लिये वे ऋक्, यजु: और सामरूप विष्णु सूर्यके भीतर निवास करते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: [[इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे द्वितीये ऽंशे सप्तमो ऽध्यायः ]] व्याख्यातम् एतद् ब्रह्माण्डसंस्थानं तव सुव्रत ततः प्रमाणसंस्थाने सूर्यादीनां शृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: [[iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇe dvitīye 'ṃśe saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ ]] vyākhyātam etad brahmāṇḍasaṃsthānaṃ tava suvrata tataḥ pramāṇasaṃsthāne sūryādīnāṃ śṛṇuṣva me
verses.translation: r ARASARA said : — I have described to you the system of the universe in general : I shall now describe the situations and dimensions of the sun and other luminaries.
verses.hindi: श्रीपराशरजी बोले— हे सुव्रत! मैंने तुमसे यह ब्रह्माण्डकी स्थिति कही, अब सूर्य आदि ग्रहोंकी स्थिति और उनके परिमाण सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: r ARASARA said : — I have described to you the system of the universe in general : I shall now describe the situations and dimensions of the sun and other luminaries.
verses.science: प्रत्येक मासमें जो-जो सूर्य होता है उसी-उसीमें वह वेदत्रयीरूपिणी विष्णुकी परा शक्ति निवास करती है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि भास्करस्य रथो नव ईषादण्डस् तथैवास्य द्विगुणो मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi bhāskarasya ratho nava īṣādaṇḍas tathaivāsya dviguṇo munisattama
verses.translation: foremost of Mnnis, the chariot of the sun is nine thousand leagues in length and the pole is of twice that size j the axle is more than fifteen millions and seven hundred thou- sand yoyanas long, on which a wheel is placed with three naves,* five spokes and six peripheries. It is undecaying and continues for the year and consequently all the cycles of the time are placed herein. The second axle of his chariot isfortyfive thousand, five hundred leagues long. thou of great mind, the. two halves of the yoke are respectively as long as two axles. The short axle and the short yoke are supported by pole star : the end of the longer axle to which is fixed the wheel is situate on Manasa mountain. The seven íteeds which draw the sun's car are the metres of the Vedas Glyatri, Vrihati, Ushnih, Jayati, Tristubh, Anustubh and
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ! सूर्यदेवके रथका विस्तार नौ हजार योजन है तथा इससे दूना उसका ईषा-दण्ड (जूआ और रथके बीचका भाग) है
verses.wordMeaning: foremost of Mnnis, the chariot of the sun is nine thousand leagues in length and the pole is of twice that size j the axle is more than fifteen millions and seven hundred thou- sand yoyanas long, on which a wheel is placed with three naves,* five spokes and six peripheries.…
verses.commentary: Sense: foremost of Mnnis, the chariot of the sun is nine thousand leagues in length and the pole is of twice that size j the axle is more than fifteen millions and seven hundred thou- sand yoyanas long, on which a wheel is placed with three naves,* five spokes and six peripheries.…
verses.science: इस विषयमें यह श्रुति भी है--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सार्धकोटिस् तथा सप्त नियुतान्य् अधिकानि वै योजनानां तु तस्याक्षस् तत्र चक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: sārdhakoṭis tathā sapta niyutāny adhikāni vai yojanānāṃ tu tasyākṣas tatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: * The three naves are the three portions of the day namely, morning, noon *»ð night; the five spokes are the five cyclic years and ths six peripheries arc
verses.hindi: उसका धुरा डेढ़ करोड़ सात लाख योजन लम्बा है जिसमें उसका पहिया लगा हुआ है
verses.commentary: Sense: * The three naves are the three portions of the day namely, morning, noon *»ð night; the five spokes are the five cyclic years and ths six peripheries arc
verses.science: इसीलिये सामगानकी ध्वनि अपवित्र मानी गयी है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिनाभिमति पञ्चारे षण्णेमिन्य् अक्षयात्मके संवत्सरमये कृत्स्नं कालचक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: trinābhimati pañcāre ṣaṇṇeminy akṣayātmake saṃvatsaramaye kṛtsnaṃ kālacakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: The city of VSsava is situated on the eastern side of the Manosottara mountain, on its shouthern side is the city oí wealth, on its western side is the city of Varuna and on the northern side is the city of Soma. I shall relate the names of those cities ; do tliou hear them. The city of Sakra is named Vaswoksara, that of Yama is called Samyamani ; that of Varuna ia named Mukhyi and that of Soma VibhSvari.
verses.hindi: उस पूर्वाह्न , मध्याह्न और पराह्नरूप तीन नाभि, परिवत्सरादि पाँच अरे और षड्-ऋतुरूप छ: नेमिवाले अक्षयस्वरूप संवत्सरात्मक चक्रमें सम्पूर्ण कालचक्र स्थित है
verses.wordMeaning: The city of VSsava is situated on the eastern side of the Manosottara mountain, on its shouthern side is the city oí wealth, on its western side is the city of Varuna and on the northern side is the city of Soma. I shall relate the names of those cities ; do tliou hear them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of VSsava is situated on the eastern side of the Manosottara mountain, on its shouthern side is the city oí wealth, on its western side is the city of Varuna and on the northern side is the city of Soma. I shall relate the names of those cities ; do tliou hear them.…
verses.science: उससे अधिष्ठित सूर्यदेव भी अपनी अन्धकारको नष्ट कर देते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत् सहस्राणि द्वितीयो ऽक्षो विवस्वतः पञ्चान्यानि तु सार्धानि स्यन्दनस्य महामते
verses.transliteration: catvāriṃśat sahasrāṇi dvitīyo 'kṣo vivasvataḥ pañcānyāni tu sārdhāni syandanasya mahāmate
verses.translation: Maitrcya, the glorious sun moves speedily like a dart on his southern course attended by the constellations of the Zodiac: He creates day and night and is the divine fath of the sages who have got over the worldly afflictions. '•e ,
verses.hindi: सात छन्द ही उसके घोड़े हैं, उनके नाम सुनो—गायत्री, बृहती, उष्णिक्, जगती, त्रिष्टुप्, अनुष्टुप् और पंक्ति—ये छन्द ही सूर्यके सात घोड़े कहे गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Maitrcya, the glorious sun moves speedily like a dart on his southern course attended by the constellations of the Zodiac: He creates day and night and is the divine fath of the sages who have got over the worldly afflictions. '•e ,
verses.science: उनके सम्मुख यशोगान करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षप्रमाणम् उभयोः प्रमाणं तद्युगार्धयोः ह्रस्वो ऽक्षस् तद्युगार्धं च ध्रुवाधारो रथस्य वै द्वितीये ऽक्षे तु तच् चक्रं संस्थितं मानसाचले
verses.transliteration: akṣapramāṇam ubhayoḥ pramāṇaṃ tadyugārdhayoḥ hrasvo 'kṣas tadyugārdhaṃ ca dhruvādhāro rathasya vai dvitīye 'kṣe tu tac cakraṃ saṃsthitaṃ mānasācale
verses.translation: Maitreya, while in one instilar continent the sun shines in midday, in the opposite Dwipas it will be midnight ; rising and setting thus take place at all seasons and are always opposed in the different cardinal and intermediate points of horizon. Wherever the sun U visible he is said to rise there and wherever he dissappears from view he is said to be set. In sooth, their is neither rising nor setting of the sun; for he alivays exists; tlm appearance and disappearance of the sun are merely called rising and setting.
verses.hindi: हे महामते! भगवान् सूर्यके रथका दूसरा धुरा साढ़े पैंतालीस सहस्र योजन लम्बा है
verses.wordMeaning: Maitreya, while in one instilar continent the sun shines in midday, in the opposite Dwipas it will be midnight ; rising and setting thus take place at all seasons and are always opposed in the different cardinal and intermediate points of horizon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Maitreya, while in one instilar continent the sun shines in midday, in the opposite Dwipas it will be midnight ; rising and setting thus take place at all seasons and are always opposed in the different cardinal and intermediate points of horizon.…
verses.science: स्तम्भमें लगे हुए दर्पणके निकट जो कोई जाता है उसीको अपनी छाया दिखायी देने लगती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हयाश् च सप्त छन्दांसि तेषां नामानि मे शृणु गायत्री च बृहत्य् उष्णिग् जगती त्रिष्टुब् एव च अनुष्टुप् पङ्क्तिर् इत्य् उक्ताश् छन्दांसि हरयो रवेः
verses.transliteration: hayāś ca sapta chandāṃsi teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu gāyatrī ca bṛhaty uṣṇig jagatī triṣṭub eva ca anuṣṭup paṅktir ity uktāś chandāṃsi harayo raveḥ
verses.translation: When the sun is in the cities of Sakra and others, the tbree cities and two itermediate pointsareilluminatedjand when he is in an intermediate point he extends light to the two cities and three intermediate points. From the time of his rising till midday the rays of the sun gradually in- crease ; and from then he moves towards , setting with his diminishing rays. By the rising and the setting of the sun the east and west quartars are ajcertained. As far as the sun shines in front so far he shines behind, and thus on both the sides illuminating all the places except the court of Brímmil which !s situate on the summit of Mern — the mountain of the celestials. When the rays of tho sun reach the court of Brahma they are repelled and chriven back by the radiance which prevails there. Conse- quently there is the alternation of 'day and night in tb«
verses.hindi: दोनों धुरोंके परिमाणके तुल्य ही उसके युगार्द्धों (जूओं)-का परिमाण है, इनमेंसे छोटा धुरा उस रथके एक युगार्द्ध (जूए)-के सहित ध्रुवके आधारपर स्थित है और दूसरे धुरेका चक्र मानसोत्तरपर्वतपर स्थित है

The relative length of the day or night is dependant up\>n the greater or less motion with which the sun rfcrolvfs through the degrees between the two points of horizon. During the midday when his diurnal course is quickest his nocturnal is slowest and when he moves quickly by night he moves slowly by day. The length and shortness of the day are measured by the extent of the signs ; and the duration of day and night is measured by the period which the sun takes to pass through them. When he declines towards the north the sun moves quickest by night and slowest by day and wheu he declines towards the south the case is thoroughly the reverse.

verses.translation: The sun declines towards the north in the months of Tapas, Tapasya, Madhu, Madhava, Sukra and Suchi and declines towards the south in the months of Nabhas, Nabhashya, Isha, Urja, Sahas, Sahasya.
verses.hindi: सूर्यदेव देवपर्वत सुमेरुके ऊपर स्थित ब्रह्माजीकी सभाके अतिरिक्त और सभी स्थानोंको प्रकाशित करते हैं ; उनकी जो किरणें ब्रह्माजीकी सभामें जाती हैं वे उसके तेजसे निरस्त होकर उलटी लौट आती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun declines towards the north in the months of Tapas, Tapasya, Madhu, Madhava, Sukra and Suchi and declines towards the south in the months of Nabhas, Nabhashya, Isha, Urja, Sahas, Sahasya.
verses.science: उसकी अमा नामक किरणमें रहता है वह तिथि अमावास्या। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.translation: There live four devout protectors of the world on the mount Lokaloka of which I had mentioned to you formerly. These are severally named Sudháman, Sankhapad — the two soas of Kardama, Hiranyaroman and Ketumat. These four jjtotectors of the world live around the naounkain Loklloka. They are devoid of malice, haughtiness, are active and have not taken to wive s.

There live the great Rishis who offer oblations to the fire. They read those portions of the Vedas which contain injunctions for the multiplication of the progeny. They perform the duties of ministrant priests and at the end of yugas they make new rules of conduct and re-establish the interrupted ritual of the Vedas. And after their death they proceed by the southern course. verses.translation: Dhruva, with devotion, holds her on his crown day and night. And thence the seven Rishis 'practise their devout austerities in her water wreathing their braided locks with her waves. The orb of the moon, surrounded by her accumu- lated current, increased in lustre by her contact. Having issued from trfe moon she falls on the mount Sumeru and thence to f urifý the world, flows to the four quarters of the earth. Sita, AlakanandS, Chakshu and Ðhadra are only the'.four divisions- of one river and are named so after the regions towards which it proceeds. Alakananda, which flows towards the south, was borne delightedly on his head by Mahádeva for more than a hundred years. And having issued from the braided locks of Sambhu and washed the sins of the sinful sons of Sagara it raised them to heaven. Maitreya, the iniquities of any man, who bathes in this river, are instantly removed and they obtain unprecedented virtue. And its water, if oftered reverentially for three years by the sons to their manes, gives them rare gratification. Having wor- shipped the excellent Purusha, the lord of sacrtfices, with sacrifies in this river, many, born in the race of twice-bom ones, obtain whatever they desire either here or in heaven. Saints, who are purified by bathing in the wsters of this river, and whose minds are devoted to Kesava, obtain final liberation. The sacred river, when heard of, desired, seen, touche'd, bathed in, or hymned, day by day purifies all beings. And those who living even at a distance of hundred yoyanas exclaim " Gangl and Ganga" are relieved of the sins commit- ted during the three "previous existences. The place, from which this river has issued for the purification of the three worlds, is the third division of the celestial region— the seat

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यो द्वादशभिः शैघ्र्यान् मुहूर्तैर् दक्षिणायने त्रयोदशार्धम् ऋक्षाणाम् अह्ना तु चरते द्विज मुहूर्तैस् तावदृक्षाणि नक्तम् अष्टादशैश् चरन्
verses.transliteration: sūryo dvādaśabhiḥ śaighryān muhūrtair dakṣiṇāyane trayodaśārdham ṛkṣāṇām ahnā tu carate dvija muhūrtais tāvadṛkṣāṇi naktam aṣṭādaśaiś caran
verses.hindi: हे द्विज! दक्षिणायनमें दिनके समय शीघ्रतापूर्वक चलनेसे उस समयके साढ़े तेरह नक्षत्रोंको सूर्य बारह मुहूर्तोंमें पार कर लेता है, किन्तु रात्रिके समय (मन्दगामी होनेसे) उतने ही नक्षत्रोंको अठारह मुहूर्तोंमें पार करता है
verses.translation: Dhruva, with devotion, holds her on his crown day and night. And thence the seven Rishis 'practise their devout austerities in her water wreathing their braided locks with her waves. The orb of the moon, surrounded by her accumu- lated current, increased in lustre by her contact. Having issued from trfe moon she falls on the mount Sumeru and thence to f urifý the world, flows to the four quarters of the earth. Sita, AlakanandS, Chakshu and Ðhadra are only the'.four divisions- of one river and are named so after the regions towards which it proceeds. Alakananda, which flows towards the south, was borne delightedly on his head by Mahádeva for more than a hundred years. And having issued from the braided locks of Sambhu and washed the sins of the sinful sons of Sagara it raised them to heaven. Maitreya, the iniquities of any man, who bathes in this river, are instantly removed and they obtain unprecedented virtue. And its water, if oftered reverentially for three years by the sons to their manes, gives them rare gratification. Having wor- shipped the excellent Purusha, the lord of sacrtfices, with sacrifies in this river, many, born in the race of twice-bom ones, obtain whatever they desire either here or in heaven. Saints, who are purified by bathing in the wsters of this river, and whose minds are devoted to Kesava, obtain final liberation. The sacred river, when heard of, desired, seen, touche'd, bathed in, or hymned, day by day purifies all beings. And those who living even at a distance of hundred yoyanas exclaim " Gangl and Ganga" are relieved of the sins commit- ted during the three "previous existences. The place, from which this river has issued for the purification of the three worlds, is the third division of the celestial region— the seat

verses.sanskrit: मासः पक्षद्वयेनोक्तो द्वौ मासौ चार्कजाव् ऋतुः ऋतुत्रयं चाप्य् अयनं द्वे ऽयने वर्षसंज्ञिते
verses.transliteration: māsaḥ pakṣadvayenokto dvau māsau cārkajāv ṛtuḥ ṛtutrayaṃ cāpy ayanaṃ dve 'yane varṣasaṃjñite
verses.hindi: दो पक्षका एक मास होता है, दो सौरमासकी एक ऋतु और तीन ऋतुका एक अयन होता है तथा दो अयन ही [मिलाकर] एक वर्ष कहे जाते हैं
verses.translation: Dhruva, with devotion, holds her on his crown day and night. And thence the seven Rishis 'practise their devout austerities in her water wreathing their braided locks with her waves. The orb of the moon, surrounded by her accumu- lated current, increased in lustre by her contact. Having issued from trfe moon she falls on the mount Sumeru and thence to f urifý the world, flows to the four quarters of the earth. Sita, AlakanandS, Chakshu and Ðhadra are only the'.four divisions- of one river and are named so after the regions towards which it proceeds. Alakananda, which flows towards the south, was borne delightedly on his head by Mahádeva for more than a hundred years. And having issued from the braided locks of Sambhu and washed the sins of the sinful sons of Sagara it raised them to heaven. Maitreya, the iniquities of any man, who bathes in this river, are instantly removed and they obtain unprecedented virtue. And its water, if oftered reverentially for three years by the sons to their manes, gives them rare gratification. Having wor- shipped the excellent Purusha, the lord of sacrtfices, with sacrifies in this river, many, born in the race of twice-bom ones, obtain whatever they desire either here or in heaven. Saints, who are purified by bathing in the wsters of this river, and whose minds are devoted to Kesava, obtain final liberation. The sacred river, when heard of, desired, seen, touche'd, bathed in, or hymned, day by day purifies all beings. And those who living even at a distance of hundred yoyanas exclaim " Gangl and Ganga" are relieved of the sins commit- ted during the three "previous existences. The place, from which this river has issued for the purification of the three worlds, is the third division of the celestial region— the seat

verses.translation: Dhruva, with devotion, holds her on his crown day and night. And thence the seven Rishis 'practise their devout austerities in her water wreathing their braided locks with her waves. The orb of the moon, surrounded by her accumu- lated current, increased in lustre by her contact. Having issued from trfe moon she falls on the mount Sumeru and thence to f urifý the world, flows to the four quarters of the earth. Sita, AlakanandS, Chakshu and Ðhadra are only the'.four divisions- of one river and are named so after the regions towards which it proceeds. Alakananda, which flows towards the south, was borne delightedly on his head by Mahádeva for more than a hundred years. And having issued from the braided locks of Sambhu and washed the sins of the sinful sons of Sagara it raised them to heaven. Maitreya, the iniquities of any man, who bathes in this river, are instantly removed and they obtain unprecedented virtue. And its water, if oftered reverentially for three years by the sons to their manes, gives them rare gratification. Having wor- shipped the excellent Purusha, the lord of sacrtfices, with sacrifies in this river, many, born in the race of twice-bom ones, obtain whatever they desire either here or in heaven. Saints, who are purified by bathing in the wsters of this river, and whose minds are devoted to Kesava, obtain final liberation. The sacred river, when heard of, desired, seen, touche'd, bathed in, or hymned, day by day purifies all beings. And those who living even at a distance of hundred yoyanas exclaim " Gangl and Ganga" are relieved of the sins commit- ted during the three "previous existences. The place, from which this river has issued for the purification of the three worlds, is the third division of the celestial region— the seat

verses.sanskrit: सुधामा शङ्खपाच् चैव कर्दमस्यात्मजौ द्विज हिरण्यरोमा चैवान्यश् चतुर्थः केतुमान् अपि

verses.translation: Dhruva, with devotion, holds her on his crown day and night. And thence the seven Rishis 'practise their devout austerities in her water wreathing their braided locks with her waves. The orb of the moon, surrounded by her accumu- lated current, increased in lustre by her contact. And those who living even at a distance of hundred yoyanas exclaim " Gangl and Ganga" are relieved of the sins commit- ted during the three "previous existences. The place, from which this river has issued for the purification of the three worlds, is the third division of the celestial region— the seat

verses.sanskrit: नागवीथ्युत्तरं यच् च सप्तर्षिभ्यश् च दक्षिणम् उत्तरः सवितुः पन्था देवयानस् तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nāgavīthyuttaraṃ yac ca saptarṣibhyaś ca dakṣiṇam uttaraḥ savituḥ panthā devayānas tu sa smṛtaḥ

verses.translation: Dhruva, with devotion, holds her on his crown day and night. And thence the seven Rishis 'practise their devout austerities in her water wreathing their braided locks with her waves. The orb of the moon, surrounded by her accumu- lated current, increased in lustre by her contact. Having issued from trfe moon she falls on the mount Sumeru and thence to f urifý the world, flows to the four quarters of the earth. Sita, AlakanandS, Chakshu and Ðhadra are only the'.four divisions- of one river and are named so after the regions towards which it proceeds. Alakananda, which flows towards the south, was borne delightedly on his head by Mahádeva for more than a hundred years. And having issued from the braided locks of Sambhu and washed the sins of the sinful sons of Sagara it raised them to heaven. Maitreya, the iniquities of any man, who bathes in this river, are instantly removed and they obtain unprecedented virtue. And its water, if oftered reverentially for three years by the sons to their manes, gives them rare gratification. Having wor- shipped the excellent Purusha, the lord of sacrtfices, with sacrifies in this river, many, born in the race of twice-bom ones, obtain whatever they desire either here or in heaven. Saints, who are purified by bathing in the wsters of this river, and whose minds are devoted to Kesava, obtain final liberation. The sacred river, when heard of, desired, seen, touche'd, bathed in, or hymned, day by day purifies all beings. And those who living even at a distance of hundred yoyanas exclaim " Gangl and Ganga" are relieved of the sins commit- ted during the three "previous existences. The place, from which this river has issued for the purification of the three worlds, is the third division of the celestial region— the seat

verses.hindi: हे द्विज! जिसके तटपर राजाओंने महायज्ञोंसे यज्ञेश्वर भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमका यजन करके इहलोक और स्वर्गलोकमें परमसिद्धि लाभ की है
verses.translation: Dhruva, with devotion, holds her on his crown day and night. And thence the seven Rishis 'practise their devout austerities in her water wreathing their braided locks with her waves. The orb of the moon, surrounded by her accumu- lated current, increased in lustre by her contact. Having issued from trfe moon she falls on the mount Sumeru and thence to f urifý the world, flows to the four quarters of the earth. Sita, AlakanandS, Chakshu and Ðhadra are only the'.four divisions- of one river and are named so after the regions towards which it proceeds. Alakananda, which flows towards the south, was borne delightedly on his head by Mahádeva for more than a hundred years. And having issued from the braided locks of Sambhu and washed the sins of the sinful sons of Sagara it raised them to heaven. Maitreya, the iniquities of any man, who bathes in this river, are instantly removed and they obtain unprecedented virtue. And its water, if oftered reverentially for three years by the sons to their manes, gives them rare gratification. Having wor- shipped the excellent Purusha, the lord of sacrtfices, with sacrifies in this river, many, born in the race of twice-bom ones, obtain whatever they desire either here or in heaven. Saints, who are purified by bathing in the wsters of this river, and whose minds are devoted to Kesava, obtain final liberation. The sacred river, when heard of, desired, seen, touche'd, bathed in, or hymned, day by day purifies all beings. And those who living even at a distance of hundred yoyanas exclaim " Gangl and Ganga" are relieved of the sins commit- ted during the three "previous existences. The place, from which this river has issued for the purification of the three worlds, is the third division of the celestial region— the seat
verses.explanation: जिस द्रव्यसे यह शिबिका बनी हुई है उसीसे यह आपका, मेरा अथवा और सबका शरीर भी बना है; जिसमें कि ममत्वका आरोप किया हुआ है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जिस द्रव्यसे यह शिबिका बनी हुई है उसीसे यह आपका, मेरा अथवा और सबका शरीर भी बना है; जिसमें कि ममत्वका आरोप किया हुआ है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: स्नानाद् विधूतपापाश् च यज्जले यतयस् तथा केशवासक्तमनसः प्राप्ता निर्वाणम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: snānād vidhūtapāpāś ca yajjale yatayas tathā keśavāsaktamanasaḥ prāptā nirvāṇam uttamam
verses.hindi: जिसके जलमें स्नान करनेसे निष्पाप हुए यतिजनोंने भगवान् केशवमें चित्त लगाकर अत्युत्तम निर्वाणपद प्राप्त किया है

verses.sanskrit: श्रुताभिलषिता दृष्टा स्पृष्टा पीतावगाहिता या पावयति भूतानि कीर्तिता च दिने दिने
verses.transliteration: śrutābhilaṣitā dṛṣṭā spṛṣṭā pītāvagāhitā yā pāvayati bhūtāni kīrtitā ca dine dine
verses.hindi: जो अपना श्रवण, इच्छा, दर्शन, स्पर्श, जलपान, स्नान तथा यशोगान करनेसे ही नित्यप्रति प्राणियोंको पवित्र करती रहती है

verses.transliteration: gaṅgā gaṅgeti yan nāma yojanānāṃ śateṣv api sthitair uccāritaṃ hanti pāpaṃ janmatrayārjitam
verses.hindi: तथा जिसका ‘गंगा, गंगा’ ऐसा नाम सौ योजनकी दूरीसे भी उच्चारण किये जानेपर [ जीवके ] तीन जन्मोंके संचित पापोंको नष्ट कर देता है

verses.transliteration: yataḥ sā pāvanāyālaṃ trayāṇāṃ jagatām api samudbhūtā paraṃ tat tu tṛtīyaṃ bhagavatpadam
verses.hindi: त्रिलोकीको पवित्र करनेमें समर्थ वह गंगा जिससे उत्पन्न हुई है, वही भगवान्‌का तीसरा परमपद है

verses.sanskrit: [[इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे द्वितीये ऽंशे ऽष्टमो ऽध्यायः ]] तारामयं भगवतः शिशुमाराकृति प्रभोः दिवि रूपं हरेर् यत् तु तस्य पुच्छे स्थितो ध्रुवः
verses.transliteration: [[iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇe dvitīye 'ṃśe 'ṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ]] tārāmayaṃ bhagavataḥ śiśumārākṛti prabhoḥ divi rūpaṃ harer yat tu tasya pucche sthito dhruvaḥ
verses.translation: JTarASARA said*: — The form of the glorious Hari con> taining the constellations, in the shape of a porpoise in the tail of which is attached Dhruva, is seen in heaven. As Dhruva revolves, it makes the moon, the sun and stars to revolve also, and all the planets follow in its circular path j for the sun, moon aud all the luminaries are in sooth tied to tfie polar star by aerial cords. The porpoise figure of ihe ^fcelestial sphere, which has been described by me to you, is upheld by Náráyana, who himself, the source of all radiance, is seated in its heart. And having worshipped the lord of people, Dhruva, the son of Uttánpada shines in the tail of the steller porpoise. Janardana, the lord of all, is the supporter of this porpoise-shaped sphere — and this sphere is the supporter of Dhruva ; and by Dliruva the sun is upheld. Brahman, I shall describe how this earth is upheld by the sun ; do thou listen to it attentively.
verses.hindi: श्रीपराशरजी बोले— आकाशमें भगवान् विष्णुका जो शिशुमार (गिरगिट अथवा गोधा)-के समान आकार- वाला तारामय स्वरूप देखा जाता है, उसके पुच्छ-भागमें ध्रुव अवस्थित है
verses.wordMeaning: JTarASARA said*: — The form of the glorious Hari con> taining the constellations, in the shape of a porpoise in the tail of which is attached Dhruva, is seen in heaven. As Dhruva revolves, it makes the moon, the sun and stars to revolve also,…

verses.science: सुख-दुःखोंको भोगनेके लिये ही जीव देहादि धारण करता। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: एष भ्रमन् भ्रामयति चन्द्रादित्यादिकान् ग्रहान् भ्रमन्तम् अनु तं यान्ति नक्षत्राणि च चक्रवत्
verses.transliteration: eṣa bhraman bhrāmayati candrādityādikān grahān bhramantam anu taṃ yānti nakṣatrāṇi ca cakravat
verses.translation: During eight months of the year the sun attracts th« waters of the earth, and during the remaining four months he pours them upon the earth : from rain grows corn and by corn the whole world is upheld. The sun absorbs the mois- ture of the earth by means of his scorching rays and nourishes the moon thereby. And the moon through tubes of air distributes them to the clouds which are made of smoke, fire and wind. The clouds are called Abhras because their contents are not dispersed. The waters in the clouds, being driven by the wind, and freed from impurities by the sweeten- ing process of the time, descend (upon earth), Maitreya. The glorious sun, Maitreya, exhales moisture from four sources, namely— seas, rivers, the earth and the living creatures. He immediately pours down on earth, wHhout turning it into cloud, the water that he absotbi írom thc
verses.hindi: यह ध्रुव स्वयं घूमता हुआ चन्द्रमा और सूर्य आदि ग्रहोंको घुमाता है। उस भ्रमणशील ध्रुवके साथ नक्षत्रगण भी चक्रके समान घूमते रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: During eight months of the year the sun attracts th« waters of the earth, and during the remaining four months he pours them upon the earth : from rain grows corn and by corn the whole world is upheld.…
verses.commentary: Sense: During eight months of the year the sun attracts th« waters of the earth, and during the remaining four months he pours them upon the earth : from rain grows corn and by corn the whole world is upheld.…
verses.science: कारण ये धर्म और अधर्म ही हैं, फिर विशेषरूपसे मेरे आगमनका कारण तुम क्‍यों पूछते हो ?। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तारा नक्षत्राणि ग्रहैः सह वातानीकमयैर् बन्धैर् ध्रुवे बद्धानि तानि वै
verses.transliteration: sūryācandramasau tārā nakṣatrāṇi grahaiḥ saha vātānīkamayair bandhair dhruve baddhāni tāni vai

verses.sanskrit: तस्य संस्पर्शनिर्धूतपापपङ्को द्विजोत्तम न याति नरकं मर्त्यो दिव्यं स्नानं हि तत् स्मृतम्

verses.sanskrit: युग्मर्क्षेषु तु यत् तोयं पतत्य् अर्कोज्झितं दिवः तत् सूर्यरश्मिभिः सद्यः समादाय निरस्यते

verses.science: बीचहीमें, आपने जो वाक्य कहे हैं उन्हें सुनकर मेरा चित्त परमार्थ- श्रवण करनेके लिये आपकी ओर झुक गया है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: माधवे निवसन्त्य् एते शुचिसंज्ञे निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: mādhave nivasanty ete śucisaṃjñe nibodha me

verses.sanskrit: मित्रो ऽत्रिस् तक्षको रक्षः पौरुषेयो ऽथ मेनका हाहा रथस्वनश् चैव मैत्रेयैते वसन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: mitro 'tris takṣako rakṣaḥ pauruṣeyo 'tha menakā hāhā rathasvanaś caiva maitreyaite vasanti vai
verses.hindi: उस समय मित्र नामक आदित्य, अत्रि ऋषि, तक्षक सर्प, पौरुषेय राक्षस, मेनका अप्सरा, हाहा गन्धर्व और रथस्वन नामक यक्ष—ये उस रथमें वास करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: वरुणो वसिष्ठो रम्भा सहजन्या हुहू रथः रथचित्रस् तथा शुक्रे वसन्त्य् आषाढसंज्ञिते
verses.transliteration: varuṇo vasiṣṭho rambhā sahajanyā huhū rathaḥ rathacitras tathā śukre vasanty āṣāḍhasaṃjñite
